L14n92.name: Mid-phrase function word
L14n92.description: Weak, diffuse firing on mid-phrase words in web prose, peaking on a pronoun or particle that ends a verb phrase (e.g. 'it' in 'food in it's most natural form', 'us' in 'care for us', 'just' in 'skip just this instance', 'up' in 'looked up'). Steered, it pushes word fragments like 'threshold', 'electro' and 'apore'; the logit lens points at closing quote-and-punctuation.

L14n2251.name: Product-topic adjective before noun
L14n2251.description: Strongly negative on the topic adjective in a writing request, right before its noun: 'smart' in 'smart home hubs', 'renewable' in 'renewable energy', 'classic' in 'classic chicken noodle soup', 'new' in 'new software program', 'wireless' in 'wireless touch screen'. Mostly silent elsewhere. Steered negative pushes word fragments ('ancial', 'oretical', 'ionale') rather than a clear word.

L14n1811.name: Answer-topic head noun
L14n1811.description: Strongly negative on the noun or heading word that a reply is about, right where the answer starts: 'song' in 'which specific song', 'film' in 'which film', 'Best' in 'Oscar for Best Actor', 'Subject' opening a drafted email, 'graphic' in 'eye-catching image or graphic', 'Chart' in 'using Chart.js'. Steered, it pushes fragments like 'apore' and 'reshold'.

L0n9.name: Closing </think> tag
L0n9.description: Fires on the '</think>' token that closes the empty think block at the start of a chat assistant reply (peak 10; the opening '<think>' about 5). Weak on other closing delimiters. Steered, it pushes closing brackets: full-width '）' and '）。' and ')'.

L24n2097.name: Digit before percent sign
L24n2097.description: Strongly negative on the last digit of a number followed by a percent sign or the word 'percent': the '0' in '100%', the '0' in '50 percent', the '9' in '59%'. The '%' right after gets a smaller hit. Steered negative pushes the model to write '%' (steered output is all '%').

L14n2233.name: Opening parenthesis of aside
L14n2233.description: Strongly negative on the '(' or comma that opens an explanatory aside, gloss, or citation: '(' in 'arribadas (arrival of nesting sea turtles)', '(temperature, pulse, respirations)', '(also commonly referred to as VFDs)', and the comma in 'Flickr, CC BY'. Also on 'means' or 'change' right before a definition. Steered, it gives noise such as 'errors' and 'gibi'.

L24n248.name: Capital letter for names
L24n248.description: Fires on the capital letter that starts a proper name or surname, most often a lone initial or the first piece of a name split into tokens: 'N' in 'N. Atzagioli', 'M' in 'Macclesfield', 'S' in 'Saphari', 'T' in 'Haft-T-alar'. Peaks on the letter itself, not the rest of the name. Steering does not produce names; it gives garbled fragments.

L11n9.name: Name-ending piece before citation
L11n9.description: Strongly negative on the last piece of a name or word just before a citation, parenthesis or comma: 'man' in 'Schiffman et al.', 'oks' in 'Estabrooks', 'ik' in 'Høivik', 'en' in 'Nordhausen', 'I' in 'RGGI states'. Also on the '(' in 'infrastructure (dwellings' and a few clause-final words ('well', 'above', 'those'). Steered, it gives asterisks.

L14n3017.name: Content word before complement
L14n3017.description: Diffusely negative on the content word that opens a purpose or complement phrase in instructions and descriptions: 'explore' in 'to explore', 'water' in 'provide water', 'health' in 'skin health', 'official' in 'official pip website', 'package' in 'pip3 install <package>', 'diverse' in 'its diverse'. Steered, it gives word fragments ('ellij', 'loit', 'ionale'), not a word.

L12n623.name: Mid-phrase word, keyword list
L12n623.description: Diffuse, weak positive on a word in the middle of a phrase where the text keeps going, e.g. 'is' in 'the body is part way out', 'to' in 'hash to', 'his' in 'until his death', 'tools' in 'study tools', and the keyword strings of essay-spam lists. Steered, it pushes em dashes and ellipses ('—', '…') and the steered output is asterisks.

L24n1478.name: 'mis-' word prefix
L24n1478.description: Fires on the 'mis' piece that opens words like 'misperceptions', 'mischance', 'misinformed', 'mischievous', 'misfortune', 'misfits', with the next piece ('per' in 'mis|per|ceptions') sometimes peaking. Weak on 'eye' and on 'to' after 'ability'. Steered, it pushes 'recognition' and 'recognize' (steered output is 'recognition' repeated).

L24n2382.name: Problem and conflict words
L24n2382.description: Fires on words for a problem or conflict that head a phrase: mostly 'problem' in 'problem-solving' or 'problem solving', and 'conflict' in 'conflict management', plus 'puzzles', 'mystery', 'complaints', 'scenarios', 'suspense'. Steered, it pushes 'resolution' and 'resolve' (steered output is 'resolution' repeated).

L14n2258.name: Predicate word in examples
L14n2258.description: Diffuse, positive on the word right after a subject or quiz cue in example sentences and exercise items: 's' in 'Jessica's failure', 'must' in 'A robot must respond', 'was' in 'which was recorded', 'you' in 'as you requested', 'to do' in exercise prompts. Top tokens include 'quiz', 'Question' and 'Jessica'. Steered, it pushes 'arbonate' and 'uali' fragments.

L22n492.name: Table field label
L22n492.description: Strongly negative on the label word that heads a field or column in a pipe-delimited table, just before the '||' or '|' separator: 'Rank' in '|Rank||', 'Address', 'Owner', 'Presenter', 'Location', 'View', 'Atomic Weight', 'Type'. Weaker on the ';' and '.' that end a code line or sentence. Steered, it writes blank spaces, nothing decodable.

L24n2416.name: 'Job' and hiring words
L24n2416.description: Strongly negative on 'job' and related hiring words, mostly 'job' before a noun such as application, description, posting, interview or market ('a job application'), with weaker hits on 'intern', 'admissions', 'licensing' and 'graduate'. Steered, it pushes 'candidate' or 'applicant' (steered output: 'candidates candidates...').

L24n114.name: Letter inside parentheses
L24n114.description: Fires on the content token inside a parenthesis, especially a single unit letter or abbreviation: 'K' in '(K)' kelvin, 'm' in '(m)' meter, 'd' in '(d)', 's' and 't' in '(s)' and '(t)', 'ce' in 'b ce', plus unit tokens like 'months' and 'oz'. Peaks on the token just before the closing ')'. Steered, it pushes ')' followed by a quote or period (steered output: ')."').

L24n2887.name: URL or path fragment
L24n2887.description: Fires on a piece inside a URL, filename or code path: 'ip' in 'get-pip.py', 'aspx' and 'html' in web addresses, 'fund' in 'superfund', 'tips' in a us-cert URL, 'whats-new' in an MLA link, 'Share' in 'Share-Alike', 'afety' in 'cyber-safety', and ']' in '[root@chris ~]#'. Steered, it pushes '#' (steered output is a run of '#'). Read and write do not match well.

L24n2406.name: Zero before hex 'x'
L24n2406.description: Strongly negative on the '0' of a hex literal before 'x' ('P0 = 0xA4': the '0' peaks at 10, other digits in hex lines 8 to 9), with weaker hits on name syllables like 'Hum' in 'humane' and 'Rad' in 'Radley'. Steered, it pushes 'x' (logit lens: 'x', 'xc', 'xC'); steered output is a repeated 'x'.

L0n1967.name: Mid-word subword piece
L0n1967.description: Strongly negative on a subword piece in the middle or end of a long word split across tokens: 'actors' in 'tr|actors' (Ferguson tractors), 'ite' in 'Amor|ite', 'oli' in 'Atzagi|oli', 'oth' in 'To|oth', 'rail' in 'rail|roads', 'ons' in 'axons'. Steered, it pushes person names ('Charles', 'Born', 'Leaders'), but that write is weak.

L20n1662.name: German word fragments
L20n1662.description: Strongly negative on a middle or final piece of a German (or other non-English) word split into tokens: 'itung' in 'Zeitung', 'und' in 'Inbund', 'st' in 'Ostermarkt', 'tt' in 'Brunsbüttel', 'zug' in 'Sommertagszug', 'rik' in 'Hendrik', 'in' in 'Schwerin'. Mostly silent on English. Steered, it gives 's' tokens ('sssss'), so the write is weak.

L23n1482.name: 'machine' and 'inter-' starts
L23n1482.description: Fires on 'machine' before 'learning' and on word-initial 'Inter'/'TE'/'Liter' fragments (interfaith, INTELLIGENCE). Pushes the model toward 'interpret' words, which repeat when steered.

L18n901.name: Colon after field label
L18n901.description: Fires negatively on the colon or closing bracket right after a short field label ('Type:', 'Address:', 'Fact:', 'Owner', '[root@chris ~]'). Writes no clear token; when pushed negative, output breaks into runs of spaces.

L23n1286.name: Example or output introducer
L23n1286.description: Fires negatively on words that introduce an example, sample or program output in tutorials and code prompts ('Example', 'sample', 'The program should', 'Observe', 'view'). Pushes toward 'output' tokens, which spam when steered.

L23n2225.name: Sampling and selection verbs
L23n2225.description: Fires negatively on words for choosing a subset: 'picks', 'drawn from', 'taken', 'divided', 'chose', 'sample', 'surveyed adults'. Pushes toward 'random', which repeats when steered.

L24n2856.name: Word-start fragment; 'independent' writer
L24n2856.description: Fires on the first subword of a split word or compound term ('Ind' in Indigenous, 'Mid', 'Med', 'Dis', 'Object' in Object Management). Pushes toward 'independent' and 'independence', which repeat when steered.

L1n1619.name: Zero digit in numbers
L1n1619.description: Fires negatively on a '0' digit inside a long number, such as 2,000, 100,000, 2020 or 20:00, mostly after a comma or a leading digit. Writes stray code tokens; when steered, output becomes runs of zeros.

L24n1155.name: Technical-compound head word
L24n1155.description: Fires negatively on the head word of a technical compound, such as 'cost' in 'variable cost', 'back' in 'payback period', 'outline' in 'outline method' or 'resonance' in SPR. Pushes toward 'method', which repeats when steered.

L24n3028.name: Mid-pieces of split names
L24n3028.description: Fires negatively on a middle or later subword of a name or drug term split into pieces (Am|ritsar, Rom|mel, Char|lem|agne, Kap|urthala, eryth|rom|ycin). Pushes toward 'method' tokens.

L23n1444.name: Subject pronoun before verb
L23n1444.description: Fires negatively on a subject pronoun or 'and', 'or', 'who' just before its verb ('what they didn't', 'you cannot', 'they should', 'who have'). Pushes toward 'fail' and 'failure', which repeat when steered.

L23n577.name: Period before line break
L23n577.description: Fires negatively on a sentence-final period, or ! and ?, right before a newline at the end of a web paragraph. Pushes toward closing quotes and triple quotes, which appear when steered.

L22n1639.name: Field or column name
L22n1639.description: Fires negatively on the name of a data field, column or form box, such as 'State' column, 'Name' text box, 'Date', 'Subject' or 'citation'. Pushes toward 'column' tokens, which repeat when steered.

L24n2888.name: 'Hydro'/'phase' term starts
L24n2888.description: Fires on the first piece of a technical compound word, most often 'Hydro' (hydrogenated, hydroxyapatite), 'Mic' (microwave), 'single' (single-phase) and 'liquid' (liquid metal). Pushes toward 'phase' tokens.

L11n1376.name: Digits and mid-phrase words
L11n1376.description: Fires positively on a digit inside a number or ordinal ('3' in 100th, '9' in 91st, the '1116' in a statute) and on assorted mid-phrase words ('large', 'run', 'mind', 'heat'). Writes code-like tokens and asterisks; steered output becomes asterisk runs.

L23n652.name: Slot before a count
L23n652.description: Fires negatively on the word just before a number or count, such as 'maximum' in 'maximum number', 'total' in 'a total of', 'reduced from' before a figure, or 'average'. Pushes toward 'num' tokens, which repeat when steered.

L24n785.name: Token inside quoted snippet
L24n785.description: Fires positively on a word inside a quoted, pasted or command snippet, such as 'https' in a pasted URL, 'NOPASSWD' and 'ALL' in sudoers lines, or 'make' in a quoted question. Pushes toward closing quote and period combinations, which repeat when steered.

L23n572.name: 'step' before 'size'
L23n572.description: Fires positively on 'step' in 'step size', 'step-by-step' and 'Step 1', and on 'batch' or 'margin' before a size noun. Pushes toward 'size' tokens, so steered output repeats 'size'.

L24n1821.name: Season or time-slot word
L24n1821.description: Fires negatively on the word right before a season or time expression, such as 'late' in 'in late spring', 'last' in 'last year', or the colon after 'two seasons'. Pushes toward 'spring', 'fall' and 'winter', which repeat when steered.

L21n3025.name: Email username before @
L21n3025.description: Fires negatively on the username part of an email address ('info', 'firstname', '.lastname', 'contact', 'chris') and on the token just before '@'. Pushes toward '@' tokens; steered output shows brackets instead.

L21n3019.name: Question or type-name opener
L21n3019.description: Fires negatively on the first word of a question or instruction ('What', 'Add', 'Remove') and on type names ('int', 'float', 'string'). Pushes toward '[]' brackets, the array or list syntax, which appear when steered.

L24n2256.name: 'cont-' word start
L24n2256.description: Fires positively on the 'cont' or 'contin' start of words like continue, contemporary, discontinued and uncontrollable. Pushes toward 'contin-' words (continue, continuous, continuing).

L24n1920.name: Name fragment, writes interval
L24n1920.description: Fires on the first or middle subword piece of a split name or word, such as 'Str' in Stronsay, 'str' in straits, 'di' in Arnolfo di Cambio, and 'Di' in Diane Di Prima. Pushes toward the code token 'interval' and its variants; steered text spams 'intervals'.

L23n1141.name: Markup separator, writes dashes
L23n1141.description: Fires on punctuation or markup that opens a new segment: '<' and '|' in tables, ':' after a heading, '%' in a code comment, and the line break before a new section. Pushes toward runs of '-----' dashes; steered text fills with dashes.

L24n1662.name: Predicate slot, writes separate
L24n1662.description: Fires on the word right after a subject that is about to take its verb or complement, e.g. 'be' in 'can be non-religious', 'place' in 'take place', 'exist' in 'do not exist', 'it' in 'keep it pointed'. Pushes toward 'separate/separation'; steered text repeats 'separated'.

L23n1637.name: Homepage and URL tokens
L23n1637.description: Negative pole: fires on web-address and site-nav tokens such as 'http', '://', '.com', '.gov', 'https', and words like 'homepage' and 'portfolio', plus the word right before them. Pushing it negative writes 'index' (the default home page file) and steers text toward 'index'.

L24n476.name: Coding-task words, writes index
L24n476.description: Fires on the word after a verb or article in coding-task prompts: 'odd' in 'sum of all the odd numbers', 'takes' and 'accepts' in function specs, 'at' and 'the' in 'the second largest', plus stray name pieces such as 'Ah' and 'z'. Pushes toward 'index' and array-index code tokens; steered text spams 'index'.

L12n1215.name: Verb after Can you
L12n1215.description: Fires on the request verb right after 'Can you' or 'Could you' in user prompts, e.g. 'explain' in 'Could you explain...', and on 'about' or 'on' after 'tell me more' or 'information'. The output side is unclear: pushing it writes stray symbols and asterisk runs.

L24n976.name: Pre-claim slot, writes recognize
L24n976.description: Negative pole: fires on the adverb, modal or infinitive marker just before the main verb of a claim: 'widely' in 'widely accepted', 'to' in 'important to remember', 'must' in 'we must suspend', 'be' in 'must be understood'. Pushing it negative writes 'recognize/recognition' and steers text into 'recognition' spam.

L24n1882.name: Scale and size words
L24n1882.description: Negative pole: fires on words of size or scope and the hyphen before them: 'sc' in 'scale', '-s' in 'Massive-scaled', 'vast', 'enormous', 'unprecedented', plus the preposition in 'on a global scale' and 'economies of scale'. Pushing it negative writes 'scale' and steers text into 'scale' spam.

L24n1763.name: Tech and name fragments
L24n1763.description: Negative pole: fires on the second piece of a split name or tech term, e.g. 'om' in Potomac, 'g' in gators, 'K' in Keras, and the software names AWS, Bot Framework, Spark and Python. Pushing it negative writes 'client' and steers text into 'client' spam.

L24n1223.name: Punctuation inside expressions
L24n1223.description: Fires on punctuation in the middle of an expression: the '()' in read(), commas in numbers like 4,301 or $656,000, underscore blanks, and '!' or '«' inside a sentence. Pushes toward closing quotation marks; steered text spams the curly quote '”'.

L24n1928.name: Ability and need adjectives
L24n1928.description: Fires on the word before a noun of ability or need: 'special' in 'children with special needs', 'specially' in 'specially-abled', 'mental', 'cognitive', 'civic', and 'and' right after 'capacity'. Pushes toward 'capacity/capabilities'; steered text spams 'capacity'.

L23n2093.name: Digits before percent sign
L23n2093.description: Fires on the digits and decimal point of a percentage or rate, just before the '%' sign: '8.25' in '8.25% annual interest', '5' in '75%', '1.5' in '1.5°C'. Pushes toward '%' and steered text spams '%' signs.

L24n2472.name: Quantity adjectives before amount
L24n2472.description: Negative pole: fires on quantity adjectives that precede an amount or share noun: 'significant' in 'significant amount/portion', 'substantial portion', 'large number', 'increasing amount', 'higher adoption'. Pushing it negative writes 'ratio/proportion/fraction' and steers text toward 'ratio' spam.

L24n2841.name: Counts before grid units
L24n2841.description: Negative pole: fires on the number or 'per/few/one' right before a unit noun in grids, displays and lists: '6' in '6 pictures', '7' in '7 segment display', 'per' in 'per segment', 'few' in 'a few rows', 'one' in 'one letter at a time'. Pushing it negative writes 'cell/square/grid' and steers text into 'square grid' spam.

L24n2539.name: Proper-name first pieces
L24n2539.description: Negative pole: fires on the first subword of a split proper or place name: 'Stra' in Straits of Mackinac, 'Car' in Carlin and Caruso, 'Jac' in Jacqueline, 'Jan' in Rio de Janeiro. Pushing it negative writes 'achieve/achieved' and steers text into 'achieved' spam.

L1n1245.name: Odd scripts, byte fragments
L1n1245.description: Fires on rare-script characters and broken byte fragments: Japanese and Chinese characters (嫌, 動), Devanagari, diacritics like ṭ and ī, stray replacement bytes, and bullets. The output effect is unclear: steering writes runs of dots.

L1n81.name: Think-close and word fragments
L1n81.description: Negative pole: fires most strongly on the '</think>' closing token of chat replies, and on mid-word fragments such as 'tablesp', 'crystall', 'Jama' and 'stainless'. Pushing it negative writes single digits and letters and steers text into dot and comma runs.

L24n756.name: Code operands and digits
L24n756.description: Fires on the operand or digit inside code or dates: 'x' in 'if (x == 0)', the '0' in 'P0 = 0xA4', years like '1979' and '1914', and the start of names like 'Crist'. Pushes toward printf-style '%' tokens; steered text spams '%'.

L24n318.name: Decade and plural endings
L24n318.description: Negative pole: fires on the piece that completes a decade or plural: the '0' in '1950s' and '1820s', the 's' after a decade, 'ful' in 'capfuls', and 'worm' in 'wireworms'. Pushing it negative writes word-continuation fragments and steers text into junk like 'sun sun'.

L22n796.name: Function and return keywords
L22n796.description: Fires on 'function', 'return' and 'should' in coding-task prompts and docs, e.g. 'The function should return a boolean' and 'the return string'. Pushes toward the word 'return' and its variants; steered text spams 'return'.

L23n2306.name: Objective/loss noun before 'function'
L23n2306.description: Fires on technical nouns that usually sit before 'function' in optimization or control text: 'objective', 'loss', 'cost', 'transfer', 'transition', 'gradient descent'. Pushes the model toward the token 'function' and its variants.

L24n445.name: Numeric types → 'double'
L24n445.description: Fires on numeric-type qualifiers in programming prompts: '-point' in 'floating-point', 'positive', 'non-negative', and 'two'/'six' before 'integers'. Pushes toward the type name 'double' and 'Double'.

L24n2063.name: Numeral magnitude → '+'
L24n2063.description: Fires on the zero or second digit of an age or quantity ('60' in 'aged 60 and above', '18-35', '180-1000'), and on magnitude words like 'million' and 'thousand'. Pushes toward '+' ('plus') tokens such as '+x' and '+m'.

L24n1939.name: Name prefix → 'token'
L24n1939.description: Fires on the first sub-token of a split surname or place name, e.g. 'Bor' in Borisevich, 'Barb' in Barbuda, 'Barn' in Barnette, 'Boss' in Cahora Bassa, 'Arn' in Arnott. Pushes toward 'token' and 'tokens'.

L24n1687.name: Mid/multi word openers
L24n1687.description: Fires on the opening piece of 'mid' and 'multi' words ('mid' in mid-section, mid-2000s, mid-April; 'multid' in multidisciplinary; 'multi' in multiple) and on 'every' or 'all' before a group noun. Pushes toward 'domain' and 'area'.

L0n1224.name: Digit inside numbers
L0n1224.description: Fires on a middle digit inside a multi-digit number or year (the '1' in '186', '2,361', '20 1 7', '9 1 1', 'CS610'). Pushes toward odd punctuation tokens like '…”' and '-wsj' with no clear meaning.

L23n2120.name: Measure noun → 'index'
L23n2120.description: Fires on the token completing a social, health or drought measure term such as 'inequality', 'drought', 'satisfaction', 'severity', 'quality' (of life), 'BMI'. Pushes toward 'index' and 'indices'.

L24n1778.name: Duration slot → time-unit
L24n1778.description: Fires on the word just before a time span is named: 'take' in 'take a decade', 'a' in 'a few hours', 'for' in 'for a few hours', 'two' in 'two months', 'within' a decade. Pushes toward 'hours', 'months', 'days' and 'weeks'.

L24n1282.name: 'Con-' word opener
L24n1282.description: Fires on the 'Con' or 'con' opening piece of a split word (Con|stitution, Con|versely, pre-con|ceived, con|fluence, con|soled), plus 'identifier' and 'and'/'the' before a noun. Pushes toward 'conclude' and 'conclusion'.

L24n2245.name: Name fragment → 'unit'
L24n2245.description: Fires on middle pieces of split names and words (e.g. 'udd' in Muddathir, 'idd' in Meggido, 'Tit' in Titus, 'hai' in Sarabhai), plus 'have' and 'write' in coding prompts. Pushes toward 'unit' and 'tests'.

L24n2839.name: Network term → 'port'
L24n2839.description: Fires on networking and server words just before a port number or access setting: the space before '520' in 'UDP port 520', 'communication ports', 'server' access, 'https', 'connects to the Internet'. Pushes toward 'port' and 'ports'.

L24n1924.name: Name fragment, '=' sign
L24n1924.description: Fires on the middle piece of a split proper name ('Miy|amoto', 'Nes|bitt', 'Mill|an', 'Guill|ermo', 'May|an') and on '=' in code assignments ('ini = 1', 'ydot = -10*y'). Pushes toward 'input' and 'raw input'.

L24n1541.name: Name starts, list joiners
L24n1541.description: Fires on the first piece of split names ('Mat', 'Mag', 'Bet', 'San') and on 'and', 'or' or 'of' inside technical lists ('number of buckets', 'underscores or'). Pushes toward 'index' and 'indices'.

L22n634.name: Determiner before parameter noun
L22n634.description: Fires on a determiner or modifier right before a parameter or value noun: 'any' in 'any fractional values', 'the' in 'the number of', 'default' subnet mask, 'optimal' values, 'a learning rate'. Pushes toward 'value' and 'values'.

L0n178.name: Science-word sub-token
L0n178.description: Fires on a later sub-token of a long chemistry, biology or medical word split into pieces: 'oten' in carotenoids, 'acus' in abacus, 'anth' in chrysanthemums, 'ylation' in methylation, 'igen' in epigenetic, 'aceous' in diatomaceous. Pushes toward generic tokens like 'and', ',' and 'able'.

L24n1618.name: Preposition before field name
L24n1618.description: Fires on a preposition ('at', 'in', 'of') right before a field, job or organization name: 'engineer at Google', 'career in video editing', 'Department of Energy', 'context of the poem'. Pushes toward 'computer' and 'IT'.

L24n1459.name: Give-up verbs → 'drop'
L24n1459.description: Fires on the verb or auxiliary right before a withdrawal, rejection or dropout outcome: 'been' abandoned, 'turned' away, 'turn' to, 'turning' to, 'school' dropout, 'or' reject or revoke. Pushes toward 'drop' and 'dropped'.

L15n67.name: Polysemantic word fragments
L15n67.description: No single pattern: fires on assorted mid-word pieces and multilingual script tokens ('ed' in Switched, 'ot' in glottalaxolot, 'cribed' in transcribed, 'https', 'Education' in ENABL, Arabic and Devanagari fragments). Pushes toward stray tokens like '//' and '](' with no clear meaning.

L23n2634.name: Formula symbol → 'pi'
L23n2634.description: Fires on '=' and math symbols (½, ×, %, ^) and on the digit after them in formulas and code assignments: 't = 1', 'Ne^2', 'r = 200', '½ inch', 'ydot = -10*y %'. Pushes toward 'pi' and 'PI'.

L22n2104.name: Math quantity nouns, fragments
L22n2104.description: Mixed: fires on quantity nouns in math text ('scalar' in 'multiply by a scalar', 'integer' in 'n is an integer', '-co' in change-of-co-ordinates) and on name pieces ('ger' in Asperger, 'auc' in Chaucer). Pushes toward 'constant' and 'constants'.

L23n364.name: Return clause after input
L23n364.description: Fires on 'and' or 'to' that joins an input spec to an output spec in coding prompts (e.g. 'takes two strings and', 'input and'), where 'returns' should come next. Pushes the model toward 'return' and 'returns'.

L21n741.name: Date-introducing prepositions
L21n741.description: Goes strongly negative on a preposition or verb right before a calendar date or year ('until', 'since', 'by', 'on', 'from', 'Starting', 'Born', 'published', 'Copyright'). Pushing it toward the negative side makes the model write month names.

L23n1237.name: Square after length units
L23n1237.description: Fires on a length or area unit (km, cm, mm, 'kilometres') right before a '²' or 'squared' marker, and on 'perfect' before 'square' in coding prompts. Pushes the model toward 'square' and 'squared'.

L24n1550.name: Proper-noun name pieces
L24n1550.description: Goes strongly negative on the first or middle subword of a capitalized person, university, or organization name ('Am' in Amherst, 'Gavin' in Newsom, 'Chemical' in American Chemical Society). Pushing it negative makes the model write 'System'.

L22n1222.name: Spatial layout, rows
L22n1222.description: Fires on words that describe arrangement in lines or grids ('as' or 'along' after an arranged set, 'horizontal', 'diagonal', 'adjacent', 'in' before 'lines'). Pushes the model toward 'row' and 'rows'.

L22n1913.name: Token before id field
L22n1913.description: Fires on the word right before an identifier field in URLs, SQL, and code ('News' before 'ID=', 'employee' before '_id', 'category' before '='). Pushes the model toward 'id', 'ID', and '_id'.

L22n2615.name: Mixed name fragments, check
L22n2615.description: Goes negative on mid-word pieces of names ('Ch|ak|ma', 'Kh|ark|iv', 'Corn|uc|opia') and on 'check', 'worth', and 'and' in phrases like 'check it out' or 'worth it'. Pushing it negative makes the model write 'return' repeatedly.

L18n569.name: Mid-word subword fragments
L18n569.description: Fires on a subword piece inside a split name or brand word ('S' in Alka-Seltzer, 'is' in Hotamligil, 'Ch' in Chimp, 'ASS', 'ICE'). Pushes the model toward scattered code-like fragments and whitespace, with no clear meaning.

L20n747.name: Variable names before equals
L20n747.description: Fires on a short variable or parameter name in code or math notation ('t' in 'from t', 'y' in 'rhs(t,y', 'fp' in 'file fp', 'x' in 'f(x'). Pushes the model toward '=' followed by a single-letter variable.

L0n1301.name: Split-word later pieces
L0n1301.description: Fires broadly on later pieces of words split into several tokens ('-ray' in Blu-ray, 'ocide' in Genocide, 'igor' in invigorating, 'missive' in permissive). Pushes the model toward generic connectors like 'and' and 'with', and it spams newlines when steered.

L24n2560.name: Words leading into failure
L24n2560.description: Goes strongly negative on words that lead into a failure or damage outcome: 'to' or 'against' after 'susceptible' or 'safeguard', 'breaking', 'fuse', 'fail', 'corrosion', 'arc flash', 'fracture'. Pushing it negative makes the model write 'failure'.

L24n2579.name: Noun heads, handle
L24n2579.description: Diffuse. Fires on the word that starts or heads a noun phrase, such as 'file' in 'sorted seekable file', 'function' after a MATLAB '%', 'Gr' in Diffraction Grating, and 'program' in program files. Pushes the model toward 'handle' and 'handles'.

L24n926.name: Trig function context
L24n926.description: Fires on trigonometry text: the 'cot' and 'angent' pieces of cotangent and tangent, and 'of', 'whose', 'wherever' right before a cosine or tangent term. Pushes the model toward 'sin', 'cos', and 'tan'.

L23n2602.name: 'of' after agency titles
L23n2602.description: Fires on 'of' right after a title or agency name ('Department of', 'Secretary of', 'Minister of', 'Dictionary of') and on digits inside code calls. Pushes the model toward colon-letter emoticon tokens like ':c' and ':v'.

L24n808.name: Name pieces, use regex
L24n808.description: Goes negative on mid-name subword fragments ('ø' in Jørgensen, 'ush' in Lepsiushaus, 'eh' in Kaleh) and on 'use' or 'using' before 'regular expressions'. Pushing it negative makes the model write browser-DOM words like 'document' and 'window'.

L23n2341.name: Split-word and surname pieces
L23n2341.description: Goes negative on a middle or first subword of a split word or surname ('ri' in kriya, 'ni' in Woz-niak, 'zew' in Przewalski, 'eld' in Zeldovich). Pushing it negative makes the model write '()' call parentheses.

L24n535.name: Comma/and after input
L24n535.description: Goes negative on the comma or 'and' that follows an input description in coding prompts ('a list of filenames separated by spaces,', 'a text file and'). This is where the processing step is about to be named. Pushing it negative makes the model write 'split'.

L23n1084.name: IT and admin nouns
L23n1084.description: Goes negative on system-administration and IT nouns in server, logging, and coding prompts ('error' in error cases, 'console', 'access', 'Apache', 'VPN', 'alerts'). Pushing it negative makes the model write 'log' and 'logging'.

L24n256.name: Latin species name pieces
L24n256.description: Goes negative on middle subword pieces of Latin genus and species names ('oph' in Psophodes, 'yle' in Xyleborus, 'om' in Diaptomus, 'bre' in Sticherus). Pushing it negative makes the model write '{' brace tokens.

L24n1298.name: Relative 'that' after nouns
L24n1298.description: Fires on a relative 'that', 'they', or 'to' right after a noun in essay prose ('a value system that', 'countries that', 'taught to'). Pushes the model toward 'value' and 'values'.

L22n2372.name: Mid-word name fragments
L22n2372.description: Mid-word piece of a split name or word, e.g. 'utz' in Gutzon, 'itz' in Pietermaritzburg, 'mes' in parmesan, 'gir' in giraffe; pushes toward the token 'range'.

L23n2482.name: Adjective 'natural' before noun
L23n2482.description: The adjective 'natural' right before a noun (natural increase, natural gas, natural resources) and 'logarithmic' in 'logarithmic time'; pushes toward 'log' tokens.

L24n1607.name: Word before a setting
L24n1607.description: The word just before a configurable setting value ('white balance', 'heat oven to', 'over medium heat', 'proper settings'); pushes toward 'settings'/'setting'.

L24n2139.name: Chemistry product/reaction lead-in
L24n2139.description: Chemistry-process words where 'product(s)' or 'reaction' comes next: 'is considered' a product, 'by' in byproduct, 'react', 'reaction', 'corrosion', 'oxidation'; pushes toward 'products'.

L21n1527.name: Random and pick words
L21n1527.description: 'random'/'randomly' and 'pick' in sampling, password and lottery text ('randomly distributed', 'random password', 'pick out'); pushes toward 'random'.

L24n2090.name: Cluster/gather word starts
L24n2090.description: Word-start pieces of 'cluster' and 'gather' ('cl' in clots, 'con' in conglomeration), and 'to' before a verb of forming or collecting ('clots to form', 'tend to'); pushes toward 'cluster'/'gather'.

L24n2693.name: Sorting algorithm names
L24n2693.description: The word before 'sort' in sorting-algorithm prompts ('insertion', 'merge', 'bubble', 'selection', 'sorts it in'); pushes toward 'sort'.

L24n1878.name: Name fragments and dataset
L24n1878.description: Mid-word pieces of foreign proper names (Dawei, Mesquita, Kubayi, Averroes) and the variable 'dataset' before '.head()'; pushes toward 'shape' tokens.

L13n40.name: Diffuse fragments and ellipses
L13n40.description: Diffuse: word fragments inside names and URLs, ellipses after cut-off phrases ('if we ...'), and 'ice' in 'crushed ice'; pushes toward dash and hyphen tokens and dash-line filler.

L24n1305.name: Word after convert
L24n1305.description: The word right after 'convert'/'converts' in conversion tasks ('converts ... to decimal', 'in binary form', 'in Roman numeral'); pushes toward 'binary'/'bin'.

L24n2941.name: Position words upper/lower/second
L24n2941.description: Position words right before a body part or ordinal ('upper limb', 'lower back', 'second half', 'Second Temple'); pushes toward 'half'.

L24n2074.name: Canvas and pro- prefixes
L24n2074.description: Two triggers: the word 'canvas' in HTML canvas text, and the 'pro' start of words (proliferation, prophets, Proculus, deprotonated); pushes toward 'context'/'ctx' tokens.

L24n2817.name: And/or after web tech
L24n2817.description: The 'and', 'or' or 'with' right after a web-tech name ('HTML and CSS', 'CSS or', 'CSS (') where JavaScript or JS is likely next; pushes toward 'JS'.

L23n2202.name: Search and results words
L23n2202.description: The word 'search' (search engine, search list, search your) and 'results' in listing text ('21 results for Schools', '1-25 of about 99 results'); pushes toward 'results'.

L24n967.name: Word before return
L24n967.description: The word just before an expected 'return' ('and' in 'checks ... and returns true', 'of' in 'rate of return', 'then' before a return or stop); pushes toward 'return' tokens.

L24n1725.name: Prime and apostrophe marks
L24n1725.description: Prime and apostrophe-like marks: the prime after a variable or digit (x′, 3′) and the ʾ in transliterated Arabic names; also 'sa' in Siberia's IPA; pushes toward apostrophe tokens.

L24n1540.name: Word before exist
L24n1540.description: The word before a verb of existence: 'co' in co-exist and co-occurring, 'could' in 'could exist', 'ex' in exoplanets; pushes toward 'exist' forms.

L22n826.name: init/int word starts
L22n826.description: The first letters of words starting 'init' or 'int' (init_subsystem, Introduction, integers, Integrate), plus 'Mat' and 'Pre' starts; pushes toward 'init' tokens.

L23n2861.name: Return/back comeback verbs
L23n2861.description: Verbs of coming back or recovering, right before the 'return' sense ('returned to normal', 'seasonal flu returns', 'came back'); pushes toward 'return' tokens.

L24n2800.name: Split function names
L24n2800.description: The second piece of a compound name split across tokens (XLOOK|UP, GROUP BY, cot|angent, tan|gent) in Excel, SQL and trig text; pushes toward 'function'.

L23n1079.name: Digit before percent sign
L23n1079.description: Goes strongly negative on the digit right before a '%' sign (the 0 in '10%', '35%') and on 'percent'/'percentage' tokens; pushes the model to write '%'.

L24n1867.name: Determiner before job noun
L24n1867.description: Goes negative on a determiner or possessive ('their', 'the', 'its') right before a noun for a job, function or task ('carry out their functions', 'do the work'); pushes toward 'responsibility', 'job', 'task'.

L24n1767.name: Verb before how-often phrase
L24n1767.description: Fires on the verb or preposition in recommendations just before a frequency phrase ('should receive' a vaccine, 'conducted' checks, 'Check', 'At' least); pushes toward 'regular', 'monthly', 'annual', 'yearly'.

L24n1088.name: Determiner in domain-range math
L24n1088.description: Fires on 'its' or 'the' and cot/-co/Find tokens in cotangent and trig domain-range text (near 'domain', 'range', 'asymptotes'); pushes toward 'domain'.

L24n2355.name: Software UI how-to steps
L24n2355.description: Goes negative on words in software how-to steps: 'to' before a button action, 'click' after 'and then', 'double' in 'double-click', and 'Auto' in AutoCAD or auto-responder; pushes toward 'save'.

L23n1848.name: Letter and template openers
L23n1848.description: Fires on the opener of a letter or template ('Dear' before [Name], ' –' before [Project Name]) and on inner digits of years like 20xx and 18x0; pushes toward a placeholder 'X'.

L20n736.name: 'Here' opening code answers
L20n736.description: Fires on 'Here' starting a reply to a code request ('Here is a Python function') and on data-structure nouns in code prompts ('array', 'list', 'stack'); weakly pushes toward '<' tokens like '<T' and '<N'.

L24n2044.name: Web-page and HTML nouns
L24n2044.description: Diffuse: fires on 'HTML', 'web' and 'the' in markup and web-page text (an HTML page, a web page), plus scattered name fragments like 'Bo' and 'Pl'; pushes toward 'page'.

L22n1813.name: Word after takes/accepts
L22n1813.description: Goes negative on the word right after 'takes' or 'accepts' in function-spec prompts ('takes one parameter', 'takes an array as input', 'accepts a list'); pushes toward 'parameter'.

L23n2276.name: Mid-word subword fragments
L23n2276.description: Fires on the middle or split piece of a rare or long word broken into tokens ('oste' in osteoporosis, 'athy' in hypoparathyroidism, 'Att' in Attus, 'ECC' in ECC-000); weakly pushes toward '::' scope operators.

L24n1469.name: Diffuse 'of', trait words
L24n1469.description: Diffuse: goes negative on 'of' after quantity or type nouns and on trait-describing words ('set of candidate', 'categorical', 'same', 'desirable', 'tooth'); pushes toward 'attribute' and 'characteristic'.

L24n693.name: Time-span noun before later
L24n693.description: Fires on time-span nouns after a number or 'a' ('a few minutes', 'ten years later', 'a month before', 'decades before'); pushes toward 'early', 'late', 'later'.

L22n1826.name: 'file' in file-handling prompts
L22n1826.description: Goes negative on 'file' (and 'dataset', 'absolute') in file I/O prompts ('reads in a CSV file', 'a text file'); pushes toward 'path'.

L19n2261.name: Rare-name mid-word fragments
L19n2261.description: Goes negative on a middle sub-token of a rare or foreign name split into pieces ('Sa|on', 'K|ana|t', 'Y|lam|', 'Dv|ur'); pushes toward short syllable pieces like 'ik' and 'ai'.

L23n626.name: Token before type name
L23n626.description: Fires on the word right before a data-type name in specs ('list of integers', 'data type: String', 'accepts', 'takes'); pushes toward 'string' and 'strings'.

L24n2670.name: Binary/register hardware terms
L24n2670.description: Goes negative on hardware and binary-data terms ('binary' in 'two input binary numbers', 'P0 = 0xF9', 'GPU', 'qubits') and on the token before a hex value; pushes toward 'register'.

L22n3049.name: Copy and reproduction words
L22n3049.description: Goes negative on words about copying or printing ('hard copy', 'own copies', 'print', 'reproduced', 'reserved', 'distribute', 'bought an old copy'); pushes toward 'copy'.

L23n2507.name: 'range' and its modifiers
L23n2507.description: Goes negative on words that set up a span or 'range' ('wavelength range', 'wide range', 'target range', 'ranging from'); pushes toward 'range'.

L24n1015.name: Market and over/under prefixes
L24n1015.description: Fires on economics words and hyphenated 'under-' and 'over-' prefixes ('under-produced', 'over-application', 'market database', 'store of value'); pushes toward 'supply' and 'demand'.

L23n1026.name: Place-name fragments and years
L23n1026.description: Diffuse: fires on mid-word fragments of foreign place or dish names ('Yogy|ak|arta', 'Nakh|on') and on year digits ('17|55'); pushes toward 'get'.

L24n1389.name: Null-value placeholder writer
L24n1389.description: Weak, scattered firing on mid-phrase fragments and link words in web text, e.g. 'es' of 'imputes', 'oves' of 'removes', 'N' of 'N/A', 'Click' of 'Click here'. Pushes toward NA, NULL and null tokens.

L22n1354.name: URL-start colon writer
L22n1354.description: Fires on the colon right before a web address, e.g. 'Link:' or 'visit:' followed by https://www., and on 'https' and 'http' tokens themselves. Pushes toward http, https and www.

L23n1048.name: Program-spec output lead-in
L23n1048.description: In chat prompts asking for a program, fires on the connective or modal ('and', 'should', 'then', 'calculates') just before the program's output step. Pushes toward print, printing and output.

L23n694.name: Measurement outcome writer
L23n694.description: Fires on tokens tied to a test, measurement, score, or displayed output: 'interpreting', 'displays', 'outputs', 'CT', 'MRI', 'A1c', and the word just before the outcome phrase. Pushes toward result and results.

L21n842.name: Scientific parameter abbreviations
L21n842.description: Fires on abbreviations of measured quantities right before a value or ratio: 'MIC' in 'peak/MIC', 'LD' in 'LD50', 'eGFR', 'pH', 'pK', and 'absorption'. Pushes toward value and values.

L22n720.name: Lead-in to 'value'
L22n720.description: Fires on the word just before an expected 'value(s)' in data and math text: 'has' or 'contains' in 'a column that has values', 'any' in 'accept any fractional values', 'missing' in 'missing values'. Pushes toward value and values.

L23n597.name: Count-word writer, diffuse
L23n597.description: Diffuse, weak firing on scattered tokens: 'running' in 'running total', 'loop', 'up' in 'counting up', 'integer', and 'retro' in 'retroviruses'. Pushes toward count and counter tokens.

L24n2517.name: Network identifier (IP) writer
L24n2517.description: Fires on the word or connective right after a list of identifiers or tracked data in security and privacy text: 'or' after 'IP address,', ',' after 'device IDs', and 'your' in 'your browsing history'. Pushes toward IP tokens.

L22n996.name: Spec connective before output
L22n996.description: In program specs, fires on 'and', 'The', 'desired' or 'Your' just before the output step ('takes X and outputs', 'Your program should output'). Pushes toward output and outputs.

L22n1973.name: Split-name fragment, braces
L22n1973.description: Fires on the piece of a split proper name or word after its first part: 'alle' in Halle, 'adier' in Brigadier, 'wen' in Leeuwenhoek, and '<' in '#include <'. Pushes toward '{' brace tokens.

L24n203.name: Mid-word fragment, underscore
L24n203.description: Diffuse, weak firing on mid-word pieces of split names and words: 'istas' in 'revistas', 'uary' in 'statuary', 'aki' in 'Yamazaki', 'rem' in 'removes', 'www' in links. Pushes toward underscore-prefixed identifier pieces such as _r, _h and _p.

L24n989.name: Proper-noun first fragment
L24n989.description: Fires on the first fragment of a split proper noun, most often 'Al' in Alamo, Almohad and Alonzo, and also 'Cr' in Crataegus, 'Nan' in Nanaimo, 'San' in Sancho. Pushes toward '{' brace tokens.

L23n1385.name: Hash-table key concept
L23n1385.description: In text on hash tables and lookups, fires on 'bucket', 'hash', 'stored', 'keys', 'lookup', 'row' and the word just before them. Pushes toward key tokens.

L22n2374.name: Coding-language names to code
L22n2374.description: Fires on programming-language names and code-writing words in coding prompts and replies: 'Pascal', 'HTML', 'Java', 'Python', 'Matlab', 'SQL', and 'pseud' at the start of an answer. Pushes toward code tokens.

L24n1635.name: Pre-call-to-action punctuation
L24n1635.description: Fires on the comma, '?', or 'please' right after a 'to learn more about X' or 'for more details' phrase, just before a call to visit, check out, or click. Pushes toward check tokens.

L24n1513.name: Name/term start, weak
L24n1513.description: Weak, scattered firing on the start or first fragment of a name or term after a title or split: 'Chris' in 'Governor Chris Christie', 'alt' in 'altcoins', 'U' in 'UMDNJ'. Pushes toward '+'-prefixed tokens like +A and +E, with no clear effect when steered.

L23n2181.name: Follow-up / edit marker
L23n2181.description: Fires on the word that opens a follow-up or amendment note: 'Follow' in 'Follow Math Help Forum', 'follow-up', and 'EDIT:' or 'UPDATE:' before the added text. Pushes toward edit and update tokens.

L22n571.name: Method name before ()
L22n571.description: Fires on a function or method name right before its call parentheses: 'seek' in 'seek()', '.head' in 'dataset.head(5)', and 'Canvas' or 'Extreme' in tutorial text. Pushes toward () tokens, with a weak steered effect.

L22n1955.name: Outcome adjective before result
L22n1955.description: Fires on a verb or adjective of achieving or outcome quality right before the expected result: 'achieve', 'desired', 'optimal', 'successful', 'disastrous' (as in 'potentially disastrous effects'). Pushes toward result and results.

L24n3029.name: Website or domain name
L24n3029.description: Fires on the name of a website, platform, or domain in tech and web text: '.com' in 'example.com', 'Chrome', 'Etsy', 'Amazon', 'AWS', 'Dyn', and '@example' in emails. Pushes toward domain tokens.

L23n624.name: Pre-'array' determiner
L23n624.description: The determiner 'an' or 'a' right before 'array' in sorting and array-coding prompts (also 'sorted', 'sorts'); pushes the model to say 'array'.

L23n292.name: S-fragments; brace writer
L23n292.description: Fires on word-start fragments split off a longer word, mostly starting with 'S' ('Sch' in Schwann, 'Sh' in Shu, 'Sl' in Slides), plus ')' after 'if (x=0'; pushes '{' and '{}'.

L23n959.name: Prepositions before reflexive objects
L23n959.description: Prepositions and verbs that take an object, such as 'to', 'with', 'like', 'against', 'among', 'of', where a reflexive pronoun ('themselves', 'herself') could follow; pushes reflexive pronouns.

L24n1203.name: 'Price' and 'percentage' nouns
L24n1203.description: Fires on the nouns 'price' and 'percentage' in finance and pricing text ('high price tag', 'expressed as a percentage'); pushes the model toward 'point' and 'points'.

L20n892.name: Word before closing quote
L20n892.description: The final word inside a quotation or parenthesis, right before the closing quote or bracket ('work' in '...to work.'); pushes closing quote and bracket tokens such as ”), **) and 》.

L22n1489.name: 'a' before file nouns
L22n1489.description: The article 'a' or verb 'read' right before a file-type noun in data I/O text ('save ... to a file', 'reads in a CSV', 'pd.read_csv'); pushes 'file' and 'File'.

L23n2125.name: 'put/bring' before 'an end'
L23n2125.description: Verbs 'put', 'bring', 'brought' and the article 'an' that set up 'an end' idioms, as in 'bring an end to' and 'put an end to'; pushes 'end' and 'ends'.

L21n483.name: Inside URLs and DOIs
L21n483.description: Tokens inside URLs, DOIs, emails and commands (e.g. 'doi' in '(Headache, doi.org', 'bit' in bit.ly, 'www', 'https', 'firstname' in email placeholders); pushes the next ':' or '://' separator.

L22n1507.name: Words before 'name' slot
L22n1507.description: Words right before a naming slot, such as 'similarly' in 'similarly named', 'variable' in 'variable names', 'article' in 'article name'; pushes 'name', 'names' and 'named'.

L23n2742.name: Position words before 'side'
L23n2742.description: Position words right before 'side' ('opposite', 'other', 'both', 'one', '-hand' in 'left-hand side'); pushes 'side' and 'Side'.

L24n763.name: Mid-word name fragments
L24n763.description: Fires on mid-word fragments inside split names and terms ('ug' in Chugoku, 'Pr' in Prisicus, 'ule' in Suleiman, 'og' in aminoglycoside); pushes '|' and 'absolute' bar tokens.

L23n927.name: Name fragments; 'fix' writer
L23n927.description: Fires on 'black' and on mid-word fragments inside split proper names ('ass' in Kassites, 'itt' in Psittacula, 'rack' in McCracken); pushes 'fix' and 'fixed'.

L24n1473.name: File-reading code context
L24n1473.description: Fires in file and data-loading code, on 'pd' in 'pd.read_csv', 'dataset', 'MATLAB' and 'that'/'to' after a file or script noun; pushes 'read', 'reads' and 'load'.

L22n1061.name: Diffuse; 'error' writer
L22n1061.description: Weak, diffuse firing on verbs and articles in troubleshooting and instruction text ('am' in 'I am having trouble', 'other' in 'other strange behaviors'); pushes 'error' and 'errors'.

L24n2223.name: Tech modifiers before nouns
L24n2223.description: Technical modifiers and name fragments in electronics and ML text ('single' in single-phase, 'receiver' in receiver bias, '3' in 3-phase, 'Rud' in Rudolph); pushes 'input' and 'inputs'.

L23n654.name: Subject before 'vary'
L23n654.description: The word right before an expected 'vary/varies', such as 'extent' in 'the extent to which', 'size' in 'range in size', or 'can' in 'can vary'; pushes 'var', 'vary' and 'variable'.

L23n2632.name: Technical modifiers before nouns
L23n2632.description: The modifier right before a technical noun in CS and math text ('transition' in state-transition matrix, 'binary' in binary tree, '-vector' in distance-vector); pushes 'graph' and 'Graph'.

L22n1832.name: Pre-'row' quantifier slot
L22n1832.description: Quantifiers and verbs right before a database record noun ('maximum number of', 'all' in 'Select all', 'each' record, 'retrieves' data); pushes 'row' and 'rows'.

L22n515.name: Intensifier before 'true'
L22n515.description: The copula or intensifier right before 'true' in 'this is especially true', 'is particularly true', 'was true', 'undoubtedly'; pushes 'true' and 'True'.

L23n2405.name: Comparative before 'than'
L23n2405.description: Comparative or 'rather'/'other' right before 'than' ('more', 'less', 'larger', 'rather', 'thicker'); pushes 'than' and 'THAN'.

L24n2673.name: Movement along a route
L24n2673.description: Fires on words of travel along a course: 'migration', 'flight', 'fly', 'along' in 'along the way', and 'trajectories', peaking on the word before the object (e.g. 'flight' in 'flight trajectories'). Pushes the model to output 'path' and 'route' tokens.

L0n38.name: Scattered content words, mixed
L0n38.description: Fires on unrelated single content words: 'equality', 'norm', 'problem', 'constant', 'rays', 'epidemic', and the first piece of split words like 'deg' in 'degenerative'. Pushes toward code punctuation such as ');' and '*/'; when steered it spams blank lines.

L24n1154.name: Graph and illustrate words
L24n1154.description: Goes strongly negative on words about drawing or charting data: 'graph', 'illustrate', 'illustrated', 'visualization', 'sketch', 'tangent', and on commas inside long lists of analysis tools. Pushing it negative makes the model write 'graph' and 'graphically'.

L24n1762.name: Rank words before 'order'
L24n1762.description: Goes strongly negative on rank or level words that come before 'order': 'second' in 'second-order', 'first', 'higher', 'highest', 'high' in 'high-functioning', and 'Higher' as a degree. Pushing it negative makes the model write 'order' repeatedly.

L13n3041.name: Quality adjectives in requests
L13n3041.description: Goes strongly negative on quality adjectives in task requests, such as 'practical', 'ease' (of use), 'reliability', 'persuasive', 'intuitive', 'appealing', and 'convenience'. Pushing it negative makes the output fall into asterisk or symbol spam.

L24n1449.name: Opposite polarity and ø
L24n1449.description: Fires on 'opposite' and 'opposing' (especially 'opposite polarity'), on the Scandinavian letter 'ø' in names like Jørgensen, and on 'the' before a noun in technical steps. Pushes toward 'sign' and 'signs'.

L24n654.name: Metadata and page-label fields
L24n654.description: Fires on metadata and web-boilerplate field labels: 'PDF' in 'Download eBook | PDF', 'Copyright', 'Location', 'Publication Series', 'Source', 'LC Control Number', and 'http'. Pushes toward 'address', 'URL', 'number', and 'uuid'.

L24n2620.name: Browsers and installable add-ons
L24n2620.description: Goes strongly negative on browser and app-software names and install talk: 'Chrome' in 'Chrome extension', 'browser', 'Firefox', 'Adobe Reader', and 'install'. Pushing it negative makes the model write 'extension' over and over.

L23n1647.name: Code start, C types
L23n1647.description: Fires on the newline right after the think tag before code, and on the opening of C or Java programs, plus word fragments split mid-word. Pushes toward C type keywords such as 'int', 'bool', 'void', 'uint', and 'char'.

L23n455.name: Average and number-of phrases
L23n455.description: Goes strongly negative on quantity and aggregate words: 'average', 'total', 'actual', 'largest', and the 'the' right before 'number' in 'the number of' or 'the total days'. Pushing it negative makes the model write 'number' repeatedly.

L23n2810.name: Before detect or diagnose
L23n2810.description: Fires on the word right before a detection or diagnosis verb: 'early' in 'early detection', 'can' in 'can help doctors', 'reliably' before 'detect', 'be' in 'be diagnosed', and 'und' in 'undetectable'. Pushes toward 'detect', 'detection', and 'catch'.

L24n1809.name: Words before size figures
L24n1809.description: Goes strongly negative on the verb or modal just before a size, weight, or length figure: 'can' in 'can grow up to', 'weigh' in 'weigh between', and the subject noun of a size sentence such as 'Females' or 'A male'. Pushes toward 'measure' and 'measures'.

L24n1261.name: Journal, diary, log records
L24n1261.description: Fires on 'journal' and 'diary' (e.g. 'journal entry', 'travel diary', 'In your journal'), and more weakly on 'dictionary' and 'routing table'. Pushes toward 'entry' and 'entries'.

L22n2096.name: Before properties or effects
L22n2096.description: Fires on the word right before 'properties' or 'effect': 'anti-inflammatory', 'antioxidant', 'physical' in 'physical properties', 'cooling', 'cleansing', and 'following' in 'the following properties'. Pushes toward 'property' and 'properties'.

L24n1265.name: Date separators, IPA symbols
L24n1265.description: Goes strongly negative on the dash, comma, or space between dates, such as the en dash in '(1807–1882)' and the comma in 'April 14, 1126', plus IPA phonetic marks like 'ˈ' and 'ə'. Pushes toward question marks.

L22n1337.name: Court-case and proper names
L22n1337.description: Fires on the name token of court cases and proper names: 'Jones' in 'Jones I' or 'Jones v. City', 'Virginia' in 'West Virginia State Board', and 'USA' in 'e.g. USA'. Pushes toward 'vs' and 'versus'.

L24n2863.name: Absence words, name fragments
L24n2863.description: Goes strongly negative on 'Without' and 'Lacks', and on mid-word fragments of long drug, chemical, or place names, such as 'sul' in sulfoxaflor and 'sucral' in sucralose. Pushes toward 'loss', 'lose', and 'losing'.

L23n1239.name: Practice nouns before method
L23n1239.description: Goes strongly negative on the activity noun just before 'technique', 'method', or 'practice': 'folding', 'brushing', 'flossing', 'farming', 'stitching', 'teaching', 'lifting', 'manufacturing'. Pushes toward 'method' and 'methods'.

L24n341.name: Before database data objects
L24n341.description: Goes strongly negative on the word right before a data object in database or data-handling requests: 'with' in 'named Company with three tables', 'the following' before 'fields', 'extracts' and 'retrieves' before data, and 'each' before 'record'. Pushes toward 'fields'.

L23n1007.name: Name fragments and 'the'
L23n1007.description: Goes strongly negative on the first fragment of a split rare name or term, such as 'Kos' in Kosrae, 'Wol' in Wolpertingers, 'sol' in solstice, and 'Fol' in Folio, and on 'the' before a noun. Pushes toward 'input' and 'source'.

L24n1960.name: Decimal point, 'point'
L24n1960.description: Fires on 'decimal' and 'floating' before 'point', and on digits inside decimal numbers like 0.01 or 1.87. Pushes the model to write 'point'.

L23n1470.name: Half after fractions
L23n1470.description: Goes strongly negative on the word just before 'half' in fractions and quantities, such as 'in' in 'fold in half', 'and a' in 'two and a half', and 'than' in 'more than half'. Also fires weakly on 'nearly', 'almost' and 'about'. Pushes the model to write 'half'.

L24n501.name: During before war eras
L24n501.description: Fires on 'during', 'of' or 'after' when it introduces a war or era, as in 'during World War II' and 'end of World War One'. Pushes the model to write 'World' next.

L22n2068.name: Space before date day
L22n2068.description: Goes strongly negative on the blank space token right before a day number in a date, as in 'on 18 June', 'On 31 March' and 'Date of Local Designation: 1976'. Pushes the model to write 'date'.

L24n1561.name: School and maker projects
L24n1561.description: Goes negative on project nouns in maker and classroom text, such as 'Pi' in 'Raspberry Pi', 'project' in 'science fair project', and 'Arduino', 'DIY' or 'art'. Pushes the model to write 'project'.

L24n2140.name: Software and program nouns
L24n2140.description: Fires on the word right before a software noun in tool talk, such as 'editing' in 'photo editing software', 'free' before 'program', 'word processor', and 'open-source' before 'programming'. Pushes the model to write 'program' or 'software'.

L22n2243.name: Newline before markdown headers
L22n2243.description: Goes strongly negative on the line break or colon right after a heading or sentence end, especially inside think blocks and before a section body. Pushes the model to write '##' markdown headers.

L22n1976.name: Possessive before 'name'
L22n1976.description: Fires on a possessive or article ('its', 'their', 'his', 'the') right before 'name' or 'nickname', as in 'gets its name' or 'earned his nickname'. Pushes the model to write 'name'.

L23n1391.name: Database and source names
L23n1391.description: Goes negative on the word just before or inside a data-source name, such as 'National' in 'National Health Survey', 'a huge' before 'database', and 'Pub' and 'med' in PubMed. Pushes the model to write 'database'.

L24n1544.name: Split-word name fragments
L24n1544.description: Fires on a word-start fragment of a name or word split across several tokens, such as 'Ep' in 'Antiochus Epiphanes', 'Sin' in 'Sinus', 'Cor' in 'Cornutum', and 'Del' in 'Delville'. Its push toward 'options' is weak, so the link is loose.

L24n77.name: Opening bracket or quote
L24n77.description: Fires on an opening '(' or quote mark that starts an aside, gloss or alternate name, as in 'Nyonyas (' or 'Flora (' and in 'word “ori”'. Pushes the model toward words that list or qualify, such as 'two', 'options' and 'includes'.

L22n1761.name: Task verbs: create, construct
L22n1761.description: Fires on the action verb right after 'to' or 'that' in a coding-task request, such as 'creates' in 'a program that creates' and 'create' in 'Use Java to create'. Pushes toward 'instance', which the reading does not explain.

L24n1084.name: Taxonomic family and genus
L24n1084.description: Goes negative on taxonomic names and the words before them: the 'ae' or 'ceae' ending of families like Gleicheniaceae, and 'the' before 'genus' in botany and zoology text. Pushes the model to write 'family'.

L23n1692.name: Word-end fragments and names
L23n1692.description: Fires on a later piece of a word or name split across tokens, such as 'd' in Honeydew, 'pend' in Harpenden, 'ond' in Arhonditsis, and 'Santa' in Santa Barbara. Pushes toward 'dictionary' and 'dict', which the reading does not explain.

L24n1091.name: HTML and code markup
L24n1091.description: Goes negative on code and markup tokens: 'include' after '#', 'canvas' and 'element' in HTML text, and 'upgrade' in shell flags. Pushes the model to write an opening '<' tag, as in '<canvas>'.

L24n1547.name: Organization and place names
L24n1547.description: Goes negative on the first word of organization, country and place names: 'World' in World Bank or World War, 'UN', 'United' in United Nations, and 'Wu' in Wuhan. Pushes the model to write 'size'.

L24n2394.name: Feedback loop and cycle
L24n2394.description: Fires on words in a feedback or cycle phrase: 'feedback' in 'feedback loop', 'CY' in 'life cycle', and 'recirculating' or 'cause' in process descriptions. Pushes the model to write 'cycle' or 'loop'.

L23n973.name: And/or list joiners
L23n973.description: Goes negative on 'and', 'or' or a comma joining two items in a list of alternatives, such as 'letters and numbers' or 'a letter or the underscore'. Pushes the model to write 'numbers'.

L24n847.name: Intensifier before comparatives
L24n847.description: Fires on the word before a comparative, such as 'much' in 'much easier', 'even' in 'even more', and 'little' in 'a little brighter', plus the 'er' or 'ier' stem in 'wetter' and 'trickier'. Pushes the model to write '-er' endings.

L21n888.name: Answer-start and quote marks
L21n888.description: Fires on the first token of an answer after the empty think block, and on 'Answer' and 'repetition' in the system prompt's instructions. Pushes the model to write quote and backtick characters around words.

L23n100.name: Commas and sentence-end punctuation
L23n100.description: Fires on commas mid-sentence, especially digit-group commas (3,294) and commas before an appositive or continuation; pushes the model to end with sentence punctuation (. ! ;).

L24n2033.name: Page and screen nouns
L24n2033.description: Fires on the noun naming a web or app page or UI piece (login, landing, menu, homepage, about, registration, title slide), often early in a prompt; pushes the model to write 'screen' or 'page'.

L24n2324.name: Payment context before 'card'
L24n2324.description: Goes negative on the word before 'card' in payment talk ('credit' in 'credit card', 'payment', 'crypto', 'shopping', 'privacy'); pushes the model to write 'card'.

L24n1892.name: Upper/lower before 'case'
L24n1892.description: Fires on 'upper' and 'lower' (also 'Upper' as a level label, 'ignore', 'ascending') in phrases like 'upper limit' or 'upper case'; pushes the model toward 'case'.

L23n2112.name: Data-structure name before 'stack'
L23n2112.description: Goes negative on the word just before a data-structure or algorithm name in coding prompts ('stack', 'binary', 'singly', 'using'); pushes the model to write 'stack'.

L24n2715.name: Words before 'order'
L24n2715.description: Goes negative on the word right before 'order' in sequencing phrases ('the following order', 'what order', 'descending order', 'different order'); pushes the model to write 'order'.

L24n2622.name: GUI words before 'window'
L24n2622.description: Goes negative on UI-design words ('graphical', 'intuitive', 'user-friendly', 'interface', 'dialog', 'console', 'command') in app prompts; pushes the model to write 'window' or 'interface'.

L22n2890.name: Email and contact context
L22n2890.description: Fires on the comma or preposition just before 'email' in contact-field lists ('first name, last name, email') and on 'by' or 'via' before a channel ('by email', 'send via', 'notifications', 'alerts'); pushes the model to write 'email'.

L23n736.name: Before 'equation' or 'formula'
L23n736.description: Goes negative on the word right before 'equation' or 'formula' ('the', 'defining', 'above', 'given by', 'using the', 'following'); pushes the model to write 'equation'.

L24n2327.name: UI click steps
L24n2327.description: Fires on UI-instruction words ('Click', 'press', 'View', 'mouse', 'buttons', 'step') and on 'Contents' and 'Pages' in how-to text; pushes the model toward 'back'.

L22n2679.name: Repeating-cycle words
L22n2679.description: Fires on words for things that recur on a schedule ('repeats', 'annual', 'seasonal', 'weekly', 'repeating', 'cycle', 'year', 'day'), usually the word before 'of' or the noun itself; pushes the model to write 'cycle'.

L24n2733.name: Math problem setup words
L24n2733.description: Goes negative on math-problem setup words ('ill-posed', 'initial' in 'initial condition', 'differential equation', 'periodic', 'defines', 'set'); pushes the model to write 'boundary' or 'initial'.

L21n2863.name: Pronoun before reflexive -self
L21n2863.description: Goes negative on an object pronoun or demonstrative ending a verb phrase ('do it', 'do this', 'one', 'that', 'them', 'anything', 'do it again'); pushes the model to write reflexive '-self' pronouns.

L21n686.name: Average before statistic values
L21n686.description: Fires on 'age' and the article or word just before an average or approximate value ('mean age', 'average age', 'an approximate', 'an optimistic', 'a 14% increase'); pushes the model to write 'average' or 'mean'.

L21n1827.name: Before 'valid' or 'available'
L21n1827.description: Goes negative on the word just before a validity or availability check ('are' in 'are available', 'not' before 'valid', 'identifier', 'formats', 'Select', 'shows'); pushes the model to write 'valid'.

L23n2609.name: Click, then 'next'
L23n2609.description: Fires on 'Click', 'click' or 'Press' starting a UI step ('Click to view', 'click on New Student Registration', 'Press Apply') and on the first pieces of proper names ('Min', 'Ken', 'Pen'); pushes the model to write 'next'.

L22n911.name: Programming words before 'function'
L22n911.description: Fires on a programming-language name or code word ('Python', 'JavaScript', 'Haskell', 'Kotlin', 'auxiliary', 'defines') in coding prompts; pushes the model to write 'function'.

L23n1668.name: Slot before a number
L23n1668.description: Goes negative on the word or space right before a numeric amount ('$' before a dollar figure, the blank before '6 hours' or '50 and 100', sleep-related words); pushes the model toward 'x'.

L24n2569.name: Front and back direction
L24n2569.description: Fires on spatial-direction words ('far', 'farther', 'pushed', 'stood', 'front-to-back', 'from the rear', 'directly'); pushes the model toward 'back' or 'front'.

L21n2555.name: Placeholder before a name
L21n2555.description: Fires on the '[' or word right before a template placeholder ('Dear [', '[Project', 'Title', 'Author', 'Chapter', 'insert the'); pushes the model to write 'name'.

L24n2055.name: Unchanged-state words
L24n2055.description: Fires on words that say a quantity stayed put, such as 'remained', 'steadily', 'remarkably', 'relatively' and 'about the same', plus 'at' and name fragments in split names (Alon|zo, Hon|k); pushes toward 'constant'.

L22n1451.name: Code task output, counting
L22n1451.description: Fires on 'the' or 'a' right after output verbs in coding requests ('returns the', 'outputs the', 'displays the'), and on 'frequency', 'number' and 'running' in counting tasks; pushes toward 'count'.

L22n2747.name: Split proper-name fragments
L22n2747.description: Goes strongly negative on a later piece of a multi-token proper name or rare word, such as 'by' in Abyei, 'ver' in Averroes, 'Arist' in Aristotelian, 'Astr' in Astronomical and 'ux' in bruxism; pushes toward 'map'.

L22n2996.name: Derived-variant modifiers
L22n2996.description: Fires on the adjective or suffix that marks a derived variant of a noun, such as 'im|proved', 'simplified', 'modified', 'extended', 'upgraded', 'printable', 'plant-based' and 'watered-down'; pushes toward 'version'.

L24n1150.name: Mixed technical grab-bag
L24n1150.description: Diffuse: fires on 'subnet' in networking text, 'confidence' before 'interval', '2D' in Excel lookups, 'locate', and capital or fragment tokens like 'bre' and 'Mont'; pushes toward 'range'.

L24n1722.name: Pointing words: hand, point
L24n1722.description: Goes strongly negative on 'hand', 'pointed', 'pointer', 'point', 'fingers' and 'aimed' when they mean a direction or aim; pushes toward 'point'.

L22n2356.name: Continuation phrases
L22n2356.description: Goes strongly negative on the word just before a continuation phrase: 'so' in 'and so forth', 'reading' in 'keep reading', 'goes' in 'goes through', and 'by' or 'to' after 'continue the story'; pushes toward 'continue'.

L24n2181.name: 'in' after placement verbs
L24n2181.description: Goes strongly negative on 'in' (sometimes 'and') right after a placement or arrangement verb: 'connected in series', 'arranged in lines', 'fly in a pyramid', 'executes them in the following order'; pushes toward 'series'.

L23n2598.name: Vertex and corner fragments
L23n2598.description: Fires on 'vert' or 'vertices' word fragments and on 'corner', 'facet' and 'neighboring', plus 'two sides' in polygon questions; some noise, such as 'ting' in tingling; pushes toward 'vertex'.

L21n2100.name: 'the' before result nouns
L21n2100.description: Fires on 'the' (or 'to', 'in') right before the object of a result-producing verb in program or procedure text ('returns the', 'outputs the sum', 'divide the total', 'the resulting string'); pushes toward 'result'.

L23n2765.name: Medical test terms
L23n2765.description: Fires on medical test and diagnosis words, such as the 'C' in 'A1C', 'lact', 'diagnostic', 'MRI', 'testing', 'HIV' and 'the test', and on 'perform' before a procedure; pushes toward 'test'.

L21n2530.name: Return and back motion
L21n2530.description: Goes strongly negative on 'return', 'returned', 'returning', 'back' and 'refer' when they mean going or sending something back; pushes toward 'return'.

L23n2299.name: Eigenvector and matrix math
L23n2299.description: Goes strongly negative on 'env' inside a split 'eigenvector' and on linear-algebra and dynamics words such as 'rank', 'transition', 'gradient', 'acceleration' and 'rhs'; pushes toward 'vector'.

L24n2408.name: Incentive and program schemes
L24n2408.description: Goes strongly negative on 'referral', 'incentive', 'affiliate', 'voluntary' and 'cap-and-trade', and on 'program' in scheme-style names; pushes toward 'program'.

L24n1909.name: 'cal' word-start fragments
L24n1909.description: Goes strongly negative on the 'cal' piece that starts words such as 'calibrate', 'calculus', 'calculate', 'Calabasas' and 'Caliphate', and on numerical or formula context; pushes toward 'calculate'.

L22n1096.name: 'using' before algorithm names
L22n1096.description: Fires on 'a', 'using', 'uses' or 'for' right before the name of a method or algorithm in programming requests ('use a sorting algorithm', 'using the Euclidean algorithm'); pushes toward 'loop'.

L24n2213.name: 'to' before goal infinitives
L24n2213.description: Fires on 'to' that opens a purpose or goal infinitive in creative and task prompts ('journey to save', 'journey to discover', 'takes risks to achieve'), plus word-start fragments in names; pushes toward 'become'. Weak and diffuse.

L24n1255.name: Confirm and prove stems
L24n1255.description: Goes strongly negative on verb stems of proof and assurance, such as 'conf' in confute and conferring, 'reaff' and 'reass' in reaffirmation and reassured, and 'prove' or 'disprove'; pushes toward 'validation'.

L22n2919.name: Rate and prevalence statistics
L22n2919.description: Fires on the word naming a measured rate of an outcome in statistics sentences, such as 'rate' after 'birth' or 'fertility', and 'prevalence', 'case-fatality', 'crime', 'suicide' or 'unemployment'; pushes toward 'rate'.

L24n2736.name: Article before paper nouns
L24n2736.description: Goes strongly negative on 'a' or 'research' right before a publication noun, such as 'published a new study', 'authored a book', 'a ground-breaking paper', 'research paper' and 'co-authored a'; pushes toward 'paper'.

L24n2546.name: Statistics fitting word pieces
L24n2546.description: goes strongly negative on the second piece of a split word or name in statistics and curve-fitting text (e.g. 'Curve Fit', 'LASSO', 'Examination'); pushes toward 'statistics' tokens.

L1n2801.name: Mid-word suffix fragments
L1n2801.description: fires on mid-word fragments that finish an English adjective or adverb, e.g. 'all|ions', 'wast|eful', 'quick|ly', 'inextric|ably'; pushes toward unrelated code-like tokens, and steering gives garbled text.

L24n2692.name: Middle/far range words
L24n2692.description: goes strongly negative on 'middle', 'mid', 'far', 'near', 'long' or 'short' in range phrases like 'Middle East', 'middle of', 'long term', 'near future'; pushes toward 'distance' tokens.

L22n1847.name: Noun-phrase joiner tokens
L22n1847.description: fires on the preposition or determiner right after a head noun ('the King of', 'lengths of', 'a minute', 'pop-up'), with no single topic; pushes toward 'object' tokens.

L24n1536.name: Award and receive verbs
L24n1536.description: fires on the verb or word just before a recipient or honour ('was not awarded', 'receive', 'honours called', 'writing to'), in award and reception contexts; pushes toward 'recognition' and 'recognize'.

L22n2648.name: Quantity adjectives before amount
L22n2648.description: fires on the size or quantity adjective right before 'amount', 'number', or 'deal' ('a large number', 'a significant amount', 'a great deal'); pushes toward 'amount' tokens.

L24n2209.name: Filenames, surnames and M-file
L24n2209.description: goes strongly negative on the name token before a file extension, e.g. 'M' in 'M-file', 'ip' in 'get-pip.py', plus Dutch surnames with 'van'; pushes toward file-extension tokens like '.c' and '.rs'.

L24n2162.name: Split technical word stems
L24n2162.description: fires on the first fragment of a technical word split across tokens, mostly in linear algebra and physics ('eig|envectors', 'cov|ariant', 'cot|angent'); pushes toward 'matrix'.

L24n2335.name: URL and citation identifiers
L24n2335.description: fires on digits, IDs and author names inside URLs, citations and reference metadata ('?p=1446...', 'NewsID=1885 0', 'Cuenca, C.'); pushes toward '&', the URL and HTML ampersand.

L20n2149.name: Domain and filename stems
L20n2149.description: goes strongly negative on the name token just before a domain or file suffix ('providence|journal.com', 'get-pip.py'), and on 'root' or 'sudo'; pushes toward '.txt', '.com' and '.py'.

L24n2421.name: Verb stem before suffix
L24n2421.description: goes strongly negative on the start of a verb or word split before its suffix, most often 'Sum' in 'Summarize' prompts and stems like 'program|med', 'scram|bled'; pushes toward suffix pieces '-med', '-mer', '-ming'.

L22n2807.name: Hash and modulo terms
L22n2807.description: goes strongly negative on 'hash' and the closing bracket after h(x), plus residue and modulus terms in hashing and modular arithmetic; pushes toward 'mod' and 'modulo'.

L22n2752.name: Rights and voting words
L22n2752.description: goes strongly negative on 'the', 'full' or 'no' before 'right(s)', 'access' or 'opportunity', and on civic-rights words ('voting', 'civil', 'democratic'); pushes toward 'right' tokens.

L24n2897.name: Words after task instructions
L24n2897.description: goes strongly negative on the function word right after a task verb in instructions ('completes the statement or', 'fill in these words', 'asked to record'); pushes toward 'fill' and 'complete'.

L22n2377.name: Adjectives before effect
L22n2377.description: fires on the adjective right before 'effect' ('photovoltaic effect', 'diuretic effect', 'cooling effect', 'greenhouse'), often on its suffix piece; pushes toward 'effect' tokens.

L23n1439.name: Colour adjectives
L23n1439.description: goes strongly negative on colour adjectives ('bright', 'vibrant', 'solid', 'red', 'yellow') and on 'in' before 'colour'; pushes toward 'color' tokens.

L24n2980.name: Page/word count digits
L24n2980.description: goes strongly negative on the number giving a count, length or size in page, word-count and spec text ('no less than 8 pages', '1000 words', 'Pagination 59 p.'); pushes toward 'page' tokens.

L23n288.name: Ellipsis and quote breaks
L23n288.description: fires on the last word before an ellipsis or quote break ('The Son of Man came…', 'the last year') and on suffix pieces; pushes toward closing quote and bold markdown tokens.

L21n691.name: Averaging and period qualifiers
L21n691.description: goes strongly negative on averaging or period qualifiers before a statistic ('weighted', 'long-term', 'monthly', 'annual', 'all-time', 'seven-month'); pushes toward 'average' tokens.

L24n1004.name: Units and rated maxima
L24n1004.description: goes strongly negative on the unit after a rated number ('24 volts', '240 V', '3900 joules', '700 kph') and on 'the' before a limit; pushes toward 'max', 'maximum' and 'peak'.

L23n2867.name: Root and sudo admin
L23n2867.description: Fires on 'root', 'sudo', 'ALL' and 'NOPASSWD' in sudoers and su/root-account admin text, e.g. 'su' followed by 'Enter root password'; pushes the model toward the token 'root'.

L22n557.name: Size and degree lead-in
L22n557.description: Fires on 'in' (or a degree adjective like 'moderate') right before a size or severity noun, e.g. 'range in severity', 'small in stature', '6 km in length'; pushes the model toward 'length' and 'size'.

L24n1318.name: 'is' before value, zero
L24n1318.description: Fires on the verb 'is' before a value ('cosine value is 0', 'current is high'), on the leading digit of years like 2030 or 2050, and on 'virtually'; pushes the model toward 'zero'.

L21n1826.name: Purpose-clause function words
L21n1826.description: Fires on function words that open a purpose or use clause, such as 'as a' in 'used as a guiding example', 'To' in 'To address', 'to' in 'to explain', and 'for' or 'during'; pushes toward 'test' and 'tests'.

L24n601.name: Body size and weight
L24n601.description: Fires on body-measure words: 'lose' or 'lost' before weight, 'in' in 'small in stature', 'body', 'muscle' and 'bone', and digits in weight or height figures; pushes toward 'size' and 'length'.

L24n2238.name: Article before town status
L24n2238.description: Fires on 'a' (or 'elected' or 'as') right before a civic-status noun such as town, city, county or bishop, e.g. 'incorporated as a town' or 'became a city'; pushes toward 'community', 'village' and 'town'.

L23n2085.name: 'col' column prefix
L23n2085.description: Fires on the token 'col' or '-col' at the start of a word, such as spreadsheet column talk, 'electoral-college', 'Colosseum' or 'Colchester'; pushes toward 'column' and 'col'.

L23n2357.name: Risk qualifier before event
L23n2357.description: Fires on a qualifier before a risk or occurrence noun, e.g. 'serious adverse' before events, 'rare' or 'common' before occasions, and 'vascular' or 'coronary' before problems; pushes toward 'event' and 'events'.

L24n1678.name: Limit and boundary lead-in
L24n1678.description: Fires on the word before a limit or boundary noun, e.g. 'upper' in 'upper limit', 'the' in 'push the boundaries', 'no' in 'know no bounds', and 'Mexican' before border; pushes toward 'limit', 'bounds' and 'boundaries'.

L24n1352.name: Relative 'that' after nouns
