L24n1352.description: Fires on the relative word 'that' or 'which' right after a noun that the clause then describes, e.g. 'a challenge that required' or 'a board game that revolves'; pushes toward 'test' and 'tests'.

L23n2006.name: Purpose 'to' and modals
L23n2006.description: Fires on 'to' opening a purpose infinitive, e.g. 'done to determine' or 'used to make a diagnosis', and on modals 'can' and 'will' before a verb; pushes toward 'elim' and 'rule' words.

L24n820.name: Health condition descriptors
L24n820.description: Fires on health-condition words: 'acute' or 'chronic' before increase, pain or condition, 'worsening', and body parts like 'lung', 'bone' or 'ear' in symptom lists; pushes toward 'condition'.

L24n2107.name: Money and cash nouns
L24n2107.description: Fires on money and finance nouns, most strongly 'cash' ('future cash flow', 'cash inflow', 'cash advance') and also 'money', 'dollars', 'payment' and 'earnings'; pushes toward 'flow'.

L24n2706.name: Ending and termination words
L24n2706.description: Fires on words around an ending or termination, e.g. 'officially' in 'war officially ended', 'ab' in 'abating' or 'abridged', 'is' in 'battle is over', and 'to' in 'to end all wars'; pushes toward 'end'.

L22n1408.name: Year and place-name fragments
L22n1408.description: Fires on the token just before a year or large number ('Year' in 'Year - 2017', 'ends about' before '65 million years') and on word pieces of place names like 'Chern-ob-yl' and 'Siber-ia'; pushes toward '(-' and 'negative'.

L24n1003.name: Split-name fragments, 'using'
L24n1003.description: Fires on the first fragment of a split word or name (e.g. 'Fore', 'Mont', 'Hor' in Horizonte) and on 'using' or a product name right before a tech name ('using F#', 'Microsoft Edge'); pushes toward 'System'.

L24n772.name: Markup and colon boundaries
L24n772.description: Fires on the tag name or colon right before a closing or quoted block, e.g. 'canvas' in '<canvas>' and the colon before a quote; pushes toward '>' tokens that close tags.

L24n2604.name: Name fragment inside words
L24n2604.description: Fires on a fragment inside a proper name or split word, e.g. 'Prim' in Primera, 'Lem' in Lemenstroopkoek, 'Fil-ad' in Filadelfia, and '-D' in Miami-Dade; pushes toward 'name'.

L23n1020.name: Handling verbs before objects
L23n1020.description: Fires on the verb or modifier right before a physical object or body noun, e.g. 'pick up' a weight, 'grip' a slipper, 'manipulate' objects, or 'celestial' bodies; pushes toward 'object' and 'objects'.

L24n950.name: Code identifier before noun
L24n950.description: Fires on programming identifiers and nouns, e.g. 'pd' in 'import pandas as pd', 'M' in 'M-file', 'node', 'string' and 'file', and 'canvas' in HTML; pushes toward 'object' and 'objects'.

L24n361.name: Rare-name mid-word pieces
L24n361.description: The middle piece of a rare name or word split into several tokens (Bam in Bamako, ver in Averroes, igr in Tigris, Math in Mathews); pushes toward 'round' words.

L22n2990.name: Company values and ethics
L22n2990.description: The word just before a values, mission or ethics noun: the 's in 'company's mission', 'and' after 'mission', 'core' before 'teachings', 'moral' before 'standards'; pushes toward 'values'.

L22n203.name: Single-letter symbols and primes
L22n203.description: A one-letter symbol or acronym start (H in HPC, R in R(t), γ, G in GDP, x in x′, C in CDM) right before its subscript, prime or rest of the term; pushes toward prime and apostrophe marks, with no clear steered effect.

L22n1968.name: Before 'results' or 'findings'
L22n1968.description: Goes negative on the word before a study-results noun: the 's in 'the study's findings', 'these' before 'results' or 'figures', 'your' before 'data'; pushes toward 'results' and 'findings'.

L24n1170.name: Before min/max/average
L24n1170.description: Goes negative on the word before an extreme or average value, mostly temperature: 'annual' before average temperature, 'the' before max or min, 'global' before temperature, 'long-term' before average; pushes toward 'min' and 'max'.

L23n1746.name: Web pages, front-end code
L23n1746.description: Goes negative on web and front-end words: 'page' or 'pages' in web-page contexts, React, Vue, frontend, Facebook, and 'trouble' in 'having trouble'; pushes toward 'load'.

L24n2010.name: Style/scheme/convention nouns
L24n2010.description: Fires on the word naming a style, scheme or convention: 'style' in 'citation style', 'color' in 'color schemes', 'naming' in 'naming conventions'; pushes toward 'consistent' and 'uniform'.

L24n2816.name: Modifier before 'system'
L24n2816.description: The modifier right before 'system' or another compound noun: 'solar' in solar system, 'star' in star cluster, 'ring' in ring systems, 'root' in root ball; pushes toward 'system'.

L23n3068.name: Facility-name modifiers
L23n3068.description: The modifier of a facility or service name, just before center, station, office or plant: 'transfer' in transfer station, 'Visitor' in Visitor Center, 'treatment' in treatment plant, 'Booking' in booking office; pushes toward 'center'.

L24n2008.name: Ascending, descending, inverse words
L24n2008.description: Fires on the word before an order, direction or inverse term: 'in' before ascending or descending order, 'pro' before inversely proportional, 'moves' before backwards, '|' between ASC and DESC; pushes toward 'reverse' and 'inverse'.

L24n2438.name: Efficiency words
L24n2438.description: Goes negative on the word before efficiency or efficient: 'use' in energy-use efficiency, 'cost' in cost effective, 'fuel' before consumption or economy, 'more' before efficient; pushes toward 'efficient' words.

L23n1946.name: The word 'look' (lookups)
L23n1946.description: Goes negative on 'look' and its forms (look, looked, looking, lookups, look up) and on lookup terms like dictionary and hash; pushes toward 'table'.

L22n3055.name: 'Have access', easy availability
L22n3055.description: Goes negative on 'have' in 'I do not have access or information' and on words of easy availability: readily, easily, anytime, publicly, quick; pushes toward 'access'.

L22n783.name: Form input and validation
L22n783.description: Goes negative on form and input words: 'input' before fields, 'form' in login or registration form, 'validate' in validateEmail, 'and' in input validation; pushes toward 'validate' and 'validation'.

L24n2038.name: Verbs issuing an order
L24n2038.description: Goes negative on verbs of officially issuing or decreeing: 'issued' (a proclamation, guidelines, an apology), 'passes' a bill, 'signed', 'ordered', 'gave' an edict; pushes toward 'order'.

L24n1518.name: Spending time, energy, resources
L24n1518.description: Goes negative on verbs of spending or allocating effort: 'devote', 'focus', 'spend', 'invest', and 'of' after 'a lot' or 'amount' before time, energy or resources; pushes toward 'energy' and 'resources'.

L2n695.name: Goal-of and -ogenic pieces
L2n695.description: Goes negative on 'of' after 'goal' ('goal of the program'), on the word piece 'ogenic' (anthropogenic, pathogenic) and on 'unknown' before values or contact; steering gives no coherent output, only 'virus' repeats.

L23n1499.name: Software library/tooling words
L23n1499.description: Goes negative on software-tooling nouns: 'library' (WiringPi is a library), 'framework' (Core Location), 'standard' library, 'Apache Commons', JavaScript, API; pushes toward 'library'.

L23n978.name: Indefinite 'a' before noun
L23n978.description: Fires on the indefinite 'a', 'an' or 'no' just before its noun: 'a number of', 'an array', 'a sorting algorithm', 'a common understanding'; pushes toward 'temp' and 'temporary'.

L23n1909.name: Unique-noun 'a', name pieces
L23n1909.description: Fires on 'a' before a singular, definite noun ('a definite solution', 'a second preimage', 'a sole objective') and on name fragments (Har-, Eun-ice, Ionescu); pushes toward 'unique'.
L23n1909.name_orig: 'a' before a unique noun, name pieces

L23n2580.name: Name-fragment subword pieces
L23n2580.description: Middle or second piece of a capitalized proper name split across tokens (Zam|bezi, Zar|agoza, Rad|ó, Ram); pushes toward '!' and exclamation marks.

L23n2777.name: Wait/last before 'until'
L23n2777.description: The verb 'wait', 'waited', 'last', 'lasting' or 'lasted' right before a time span or deadline ('wait until', 'lasted until'); pushes toward 'until', 'till' and 'hasta'.

L22n1430.name: Size and dimension terms
L22n1430.description: Dimension and size words such as 'width', 'canvas', 'rectangle', 'inches', 'metres', and the 'x' in 800x600 or 24x36 (negative); pushes toward 'width' and 'Width'.

L22n74.name: File types, URLs, closers
L22n74.description: File-type, protocol and code-name tokens ('pdf', 'https', '.py', 'PDF', 'IPv', 'Swift') inside references and code; pushes toward closing code punctuation such as ')'] and quote-comma endings.

L23n1473.name: 'First'/'last' before 'name'
L23n1473.description: The word 'first' or 'last' (also 'girl', 'woman', 'boy') right before 'name' in a personal-info field such as first name or last name; pushes toward 'name', 'names' and '_name'.

L23n2263.name: Word before 'activity'
L23n2263.description: The adjective or noun right before an event noun, mainly 'volcanic', 'brain', 'magma', 'earthquake' and 'hyper' (hypermethylation); pushes toward 'activity'.

L23n1890.name: Roman and regnal numerals
L23n1890.description: Roman numerals and regnal or ordinal numbers, such as the 'X' in Alfonso X, 'ii' in Rhetoric ii, 'XII' and 'Vol. VII' (negative); pushes toward Roman numerals like 'VI', 'IX' and 'iv'.

L23n2334.name: URL and POST words
L23n2334.description: The 'http' or 'https' token in URLs, and verbs like 'send' and 'receives' in web-request or PHP text; pushes toward 'POST' and 'post' (HTTP method).

L23n1574.name: Modifier before expected noun
L23n1574.description: Words right before an expected noun in technical text, such as 'root', 'the', 'personal', 'partial', 'quantum' (negative); pushes toward 'file' and 'File'.

L22n1492.name: Magnitude words before 'of'
L22n1492.description: Size or magnitude words right before 'of' or 'to' ('scales of', 'tens of', 'billions of', 'microscopic to', 'energies') (negative); pushes toward 'order', as in order of magnitude.

L24n1795.name: Study-design and sample words
L24n1795.description: Research-design words in study descriptions, such as 'larger', 'representative', 'sample', 'randomized', 'mixed' and 'survey' (negative); pushes toward 'sample' and 'Sample'.

L24n1310.name: Middle of split names
L24n1310.description: The middle piece of a proper name or foreign word split into tokens, such as 'ago' in Zara|ago|za or 'ang' in Bamb|ang (negative); pushes toward 'members' and 'member'.

L24n2899.name: Gadget feature lists
L24n2899.description: Commas and gadget nouns in product-feature lists, such as 'battery', 'camera', 'handheld', 'microphone' and 'compact'; pushes toward 'port' and 'Port'.

L20n2476.name: 'Called' before defined term
L20n2476.description: 'called', 'known as', 'termed' or 'referred to as' right before a term being named or defined, and 'least' in 'at least' (negative); pushes toward markdown '**' and '__' tokens.

L24n1994.name: Adjective before 'system'
L24n1994.description: The adjective right before 'system' or 'systems', such as 'ecological', 'biological', 'socio', 'agricultural' or 'distributed' (negative); pushes toward 'system' and 'systems'.

L23n1732.name: Relation words, math problems
L23n1732.description: Words in math and finance problem text right before the key relation, such as 'compounded', 'paying', 'look', 'inversely' or 'with' (negative); pushes toward 'linear' and 'Linear'.

L22n1964.name: Word before 'conditions'
L22n1964.description: The word right before 'conditions' or 'circumstances', such as 'under', 'certain', 'special', 'harsh' or 'favourable' ('under differing lighting conditions'); pushes toward 'conditions'.

L1n1682.name: Mid-word subword pieces
L1n1682.description: The middle piece of a word split into tokens, mostly 'com' in 'sarcomas' and 'accommodate', plus 'suspects' and 'unknown'; pushes toward word-ending pieces like 'ment' and 'imony', and newlines when steered.

L22n311.name: Units/variables before 'equals'
L22n311.description: Unit nouns (metres, feet, miles, kilometres, inch) and single-letter variables like 'n' or 'I' right before 'is' or '=' in measurements and formulas; pushes toward 'equal' and 'equals'.

L23n1106.name: Programming language names
L23n1106.description: Programming and web-tech names in coding prompts, such as 'JavaScript', 'jQuery', 'TypeScript', 'PHP', 'JSON', 'Vue' and '.js' (negative); pushes toward 'object' and 'objects'.

L23n2497.name: Submit or apply slot
L23n2497.description: Negative on the word just before a verb or noun about applying, submitting, or approval, e.g. 'submit <a>', 'applied <to>', 'approval <to>', 'Award', 'candidate'. Pushes the model toward 'application'.

L24n1746.name: Persistence after still/remain
L24n1746.description: Positive on 'still', 'remain', 'oldest', 'longest', and the 'a/an' after 'has been' in statements of a continuing state ('is still molten', 'still on display'). Writes 'active' and steers into repetition.

L24n523.name: 'by' in change amounts
L24n523.description: Negative on 'by' after change verbs that give a size of change ('cut ... by', 'reduce ... by', 'off by', 'by a variety'), and on 'a' after 'multiply by'. Pushes toward 'factor'.

L23n2383.name: Enough and sufficiency predicates
L23n2383.description: Negative on the verb, 'not', or 'usually' right after a subject when the sentence says something is enough, suitable, or needed ('will be', 'is suitable', 'not enough', 'usually enough'). Pushes 'enough' and 'sufficient'.

L24n1949.name: Chemical-name mid-word fragments
L24n1949.description: Positive on a middle or late subword piece of long technical words (chemicals, species, breeds), e.g. 'doc|os|ah', 'ole' in oleic, 'oct' in octaBDE, 'c' in carambola. Also on digits in '3-phase' and 'omega-3'. Writes 'four' and 'three'.

L21n1288.name: Comma before result clause
L21n1288.description: Positive on the comma, 'the', or 'to' that opens a result clause in API or function docs, e.g. 'If the argument chars has more than n characters<,>' and 'result set'. Pushes 'result'.

L23n2503.name: Negation before mean/necessarily
L23n2503.description: Positive on the negator 'not', 'n't', or 'non' in 'does not mean', 'doesn't have to be', 'does not necessarily'. Writes 'equals' only weakly.

L24n876.name: Article 'a' in definitions
L24n876.description: Positive on 'a' or 'an' opening a noun phrase in definitional or geometry sentences ('a closed curve', 'is a polygon', 'a frustum'), with weaker firing on some digits. Writes 'point'.

L22n597.name: Sentence end before connective
L22n597.description: Negative on closing punctuation that ends a quoted or question sentence ('Why me<?”>', 'What sound does that make<?">'), and on sentence-end periods. Pushes sentence-initial connectives like 'However', 'Therefore', 'Since'.

L22n1791.name: Browser data, login storage
L22n1791.description: Negative on nouns and commas in lists about browser or account data ('browsing history, cookies', 'passwords', 'login', 'persistent', 'stored by'). Pushes 'session'.

L20n2364.name: Stem before -like suffix
L20n2364.description: Positive on the noun or adjective stem right before a hyphen or '-like'/'-style' modifier: 'apple' in apple-like, 'Earth' in Earth-like, 'nano' in nanoscale, 'ad' in ballad-style. Pushes '-like' and '-style'.

L24n2614.name: Math term stems, integrate
L24n2614.description: Positive on a mid-word piece of a math or physics term during calculus or physics text ('quadr' in quadrature, 'Indef' in indefinite, 'attenuation', 'lux' in iso-lux). Pushes 'integr-' words like 'integrate'.

L23n896.name: Digits and name pieces
L23n896.description: Positive on the last digit of a year ('19<3>2', '194<5>') and on the middle subword of a surname or proper noun ('Hotamis<lig>il', 'Leth Jø<rg>ensen', 'Nag<asaki>'). Writes 'len' fragments.

L13n1255.name: Numbered list opener punctuation
L13n1255.description: Negative on the '.' or ':' right after a list number or item heading in chat answers ('1<.>', 'Create a filing system<:>'), and on the first word after '</think>'. Writes odd code-like tokens.

L23n1055.name: Placement and arrangement words
L23n1055.description: Negative on words about how things are placed or arranged: 'randomly' in 'randomly distributed', 'placed', 'relative', 'layout', 'desired shape'. Pushes 'position' and its variants.

L2n1596.name: Fixed-phrase second word
L2n1596.description: Negative on the second word of fixed phrases: 'of' in 'an average of', 'only' in 'not only ... but also', 'of' in 'law of'. Writes multilingual junk tokens at this early layer.

L24n1100.name: Word-start fragments, imm
L24n1100.description: Negative on the first subword fragment of a word split into pieces, especially 'Imp', 'imm', 'pr', 'sup' ('impr|actical', 'FOR|IMM|EDIATE', 'sup|ran|ational'). Pushes 'quickly', 'immediate', 'instant'.

L23n1354.name: Viewpoint and above/below words
L23n1354.description: Negative on 'from' after a viewing or position verb ('seen from', 'viewed from', 'crushed from'), and on vertical location words ('below', 'buried', 'layer', 'sink'). Pushes 'above' and 'below'.

L24n1420.name: Modifier before conditions
L24n1420.description: Negative on an adjective right before a noun about setting or circumstances: 'initial' in 'initial condition', 'initial spectrum', 'initial investment'; 'organizational' and 'favourable' before conditions; 'natural' before relief. Pushes 'conditions'.

L23n1133.name: Data import/export verbs
L23n1133.description: Fires on verbs and nouns for moving data in or out of a file or tool (copy, export, import, upload, Excel, SQL), peaking on the word just before the target such as 'into' or 'to'. Pushes the model toward the word 'import'.

L24n991.name: Place names after 'in'
L24n991.description: Fires on the token just before a place name, such as 'in' in 'based in' or 'in Toronto', 'of' in 'University of', and commas in lists of cities and states. Pushes the model to name a city or US location.

L24n594.name: Article before array/list
L24n594.description: Goes strongly negative on the article or 'of' just before a collection noun in coding prompts ('stores them in an array', 'a list of integers', 'sorts'). Pushing it negative makes the model repeat 'list'.

L21n2482.name: Negation 'not' and count
L21n2482.description: Goes strongly negative on 'not' or 'NOT' after is/are/do ('is not eligible', 'NOT recommended', 'not required'), and on count/counted/counting words. Pushing it negative makes the model spam 'count'.

L23n1638.name: Life duration and remaining
L23n1638.description: Fires on 'life' meaning lifespan or duration ('a life of four years', 'life expectancy') and on words like 'last' and 'remains' in similar senses. Pushes the model toward 'remaining', 'still' and 'left'.

L23n2189.name: Optimization and optimal
L23n2189.description: Goes strongly negative on words about finding a best value: 'optim' in optimisation/optimal, 'minim' in minimising, 'to find the optimal', linear programming, gradient descent. Pushed negative, it makes the model write max, maximize and min.

L22n2524.name: Option and choice words
L22n2524.description: Fires on the modifier just before 'option(s)' or 'way' in choice phrases: 'viable', 'safe', 'two', 'three', 'another', 'other', 'available'. Pushes the model toward 'option' and 'options'.

L24n2134.name: 'Case' in set phrases
L24n2134.description: Goes strongly negative on the determiner or preposition right before 'case' in set phrases ('in any case', 'the case', 'in that case', 'in the case of', 'in addition'). Pushing it negative makes the model write 'case' and 'case study'.

L23n1897.name: Word before 'difference'
L23n1897.description: Fires on the word just before 'difference' ('common', 'potential', 'temperature', 'find the') and in add-or-subtract wording. Pushes the model toward 'difference'.

L23n1254.name: Drawing and geometry determiners
L23n1254.description: Goes strongly negative on articles and prepositions before shape or drawing nouns ('a sheet of paper', 'the given figure', 'closed curve', 'vector equation of'). Pushing it negative makes the model write 'coordinate'.

L23n716.name: 'that' in coding specs
L23n716.description: Fires on 'that' right after function, script or program in coding requests ('Write a JavaScript function that', 'Create a PHP script that'), and on 'error' in validation specs. Pushes the model toward 'check' and 'checks'.

L23n603.name: Function-related terms, diffuse
L23n603.description: Fires diffusely on words just before a function-like noun: 'AWS' before 'Lambda', 'asynchronous' before events, 'a method that', 'a subroutine'. Pushes the model toward 'function' and 'functions'.

L24n1142.name: List-item numeral markers
L24n1142.description: Goes strongly negative on the number or letter that starts a numbered list item ('1' in '1. Encourage discourse', 'a' in 'a. Electric shock', '2' in '2. Start young'). Pushing it negative makes the model spam ')' brackets.

L24n1526.name: Code keywords and backticks
L24n1526.description: Fires on the word right after a command or keyword in code and terminal text ('du -sh', 'CREATE TABLE', 'ORDER BY', 'echo'), and on 'All Rights' in footers. Pushing it negative makes the model emit backticks.

L23n887.name: 'be/to' before 'address'
L23n887.description: Goes strongly negative on 'be', 'to', 'been' or 'being' just before a verb of tackling a need ('must be filled', 'to surmount', 'to mitigate', 'had been eliminated'). Pushes the model toward 'address' and 'addresses'.

L24n39.name: Digits inside numbers/dates
L24n39.description: Fires on digits and punctuation inside numbers, years, dates and times ('the 9 in 1970s', 'x' in 0x8, ':' in 01:06). Pushes toward garbled symbols and asterisk spam, so the effect is noisy.

L23n2186.name: Upper and lower bounds
L23n2186.description: Fires on 'upper' and 'lower' (and 'lowest', 'higher') in bound and limit phrases: 'upper limit', 'lower class', 'upper threshold', 'lower melting point'. Pushes the model toward 'upper' and 'lower' bounds.

L23n3002.name: Greek and single-letter labels
L23n3002.description: Goes strongly negative on Greek letters and single-letter labels (β, α, γ, n, y, C) right before a hyphen or as a variable ('β-adrenomimetic', 'n-bit', 'y-coordinate'). Pushes toward the hyphen tokens ')-' and '-'.

L22n868.name: Token before proper names
L22n868.description: Fires on the short prefix just before a proper name ('St' in 'St. Paul's', 'Sch' in 'Schleper', 'at' before 'Google', 'by' before a name). Pushes the model toward 'null' with weak effect.

L23n1678.name: Mid-word subword fragments
L23n1678.description: Goes strongly negative on the second piece of a word or name split into tokens, or the part after a hyphen ('-g' in God-given, 'is' in Bois, 'mon' in Cremonesi). Pushes the model to start word fragments like 'str'.

L22n958.name: Requirement slot before 'condition'
L22n958.description: Fires on the word just before a requirement noun is expected, e.g. 'as a [condition]', 'these [requirements]', 'the [criteria]' after meets/satisfy/fulfill, and on 'necessary', 'minimal', 'mandatory', 'prerequisite'. Pushes the model toward 'condition(s)'.

L22n681.name: Copula after a subject
L22n681.description: Fires on 'is' or 'are' right after a noun subject, e.g. 'Its domain [is]', 'chars [are]', 'Q [is]', plus scattered '=' in code. Pushes toward opening brackets '[{'. Weak and diffuse.

L24n850.name: Modifier before 'term'
L24n850.description: Fires on a modifier or noun just before a technical noun is due, e.g. 'the [first] set', 'Error [tolerance]', 'sums of the product [terms]', 'Lorentz [force]'. Pushes toward 'term(s)'.

L24n2582.name: Pronoun after 'what'
L24n2582.description: Fires on the word right after 'what' or 'which', e.g. 'what [it] takes', 'what [it] means', 'what [you] have', 'Crypto [which]', where 'mean(s)' comes next. Pushes toward 'mean'.

L20n3063.name: Words introducing a table
L20n3063.description: Fires on words that announce an upcoming list, table or figure, e.g. 'the [following] method', 'listed [below]', 'as you can see in the chart [below]', 'Let's', 'illustrated [below]'. Pushes toward 'table'.

L23n2646.name: 'on' before a date
L23n2646.description: Fires on 'on' or 'On' right before a day or date, e.g. 'born [on]', 'died [on] Monday', 'at midnight [on] November', 'held [on] Saturday'. Pushes toward month names.

L24n491.name: Mid-name fragment before 'string'
L24n491.description: Fires on a middle piece of a split proper name, e.g. 'Mart|el', 'Dal|mau', 'Hert|ford', 'Proudh|on', 'Merc|ier', often a capital letter or 'P' inside a surname. Pushes toward 'string'. The triggers share no concept.

L23n934.name: Determiner after 'highlight'
L23n934.description: Fires on the word after a list-introducing verb, e.g. 'highlighting [its]', 'highlight [the]', 'outlining [the]', 'focusing on [the]', 'Here are [some]', where 'key' comes next. Pushes toward 'key'.

L20n373.name: Year digits in citations
L20n373.description: Fires on the last one or two digits of a year in a citation or date, e.g. 'Levy, 200[9]', 'Hebant-Mauri, 197[3]', 'May 27, 185[7]', 'January, 201[8]'. Pushes toward ';' separators.

L24n818.name: 'am' fragments and 'University'
L24n818.description: Fires on the 'am' piece inside split words, e.g. 'Hot|am|isligil', 'Am|oretti', 'Am|orphous', 'Therm|am', and on 'University' before 'of'. Pushes toward 'moment(s)'. Two unrelated triggers.

L21n1674.name: 'a' before result nouns
L21n1674.description: Fires on 'a' or 'as' that opens a noun phrase after 'is', 'are' or 'as', e.g. 'they are [a] result', 'as [a] basis', 'is [a] consequence', 'can be [a] sign'. Pushes toward 'function'. The link between trigger and output is weak.

L24n2212.name: Framework name before 'app'
L24n2212.description: Fires on a framework or tool name just before 'application' or 'app' is expected, e.g. 'Using Python and [Flask]', 'Develop a Vue[.js] application', 'secure ... using [Flask]'. Pushes toward 'app'.

L21n1153.name: Enumerator labels before ')'
L21n1153.description: Fires on the letter or roman numeral inside a list label, e.g. '(a', '(b', '(ii', 'a', 'i', just before its closing parenthesis. Pushes toward ')'.

L24n1193.name: Pinyin syllables in names
L24n1193.description: Fires on a romanized Chinese syllable inside a name or term, mostly mid-word, e.g. 'Y[uen]', 'Sh[ing]-Y[ing]', 'Qing-z[hu]', 'Nanjing Xia[oz]huang'. Pushes toward pinyin endings like 'ian', 'iang', 'ao'.

L24n2918.name: 'way/path/moving' before 'to/of'
L24n2918.description: Fires on a noun or verb that takes a following 'of', 'to' or 'forward' complement, e.g. 'before [moving] to', 'the [path] to pursue', 'a [way] of recognising', 'from this [point]', 'continue to do [so]'. Pushes toward 'moving' and 'forward'.

L19n972.name: Tech-text word pieces
L19n972.description: Fires on the word piece that ends a compound or identifier in technical or contact text, e.g. 'sh|ower', 'pip' in pip3, 'sudo', 'info' before '@', 'Consumer' in a package path, 'install' in a shell line. Pushes toward underscores '_'.

L23n2838.name: Slot before 'target'
L23n2838.description: Fires on the adjective or noun right before 'target' is expected, e.g. 'a promising [target]', 'vulnerable [targets]', 'a valuable [target]', 'therapeutic', 'viral', 'toxin'. Pushes toward 'target'.

L24n1691.name: Chemical-name word pieces
L24n1691.description: Fires on a middle or final piece of a long chemistry, biochemistry or drug name split into tokens, e.g. 'beta-car|otene', 'Amin|ogly|coside', 'glyc|ogen', 'phosphoryl|ase', 'nit|rogen'. Pushes toward 'bin'. Trigger and output do not match.

L24n3017.name: 'sh'/'arch' word starts
L24n3017.description: Fires on the first piece of words starting with 'sh' or 'arch', e.g. 'sh|ape', 'sh|aking', 'Arch|itect', 'arch|bishop', and on 'egg' or 'nut' before a '-shaped' compound. Pushes toward 'shape' and 'form'.

L22n2844.name: Number before 'fold/times'
L22n2844.description: Fires on the number or approximate word right before a multiplier, e.g. 'ten[fold]', 'a million[-fold]', 'three[-fold]', 'ten times', 'nearly', 'almost', 'up to'. Pushes toward 'double' or 'twice'.

L24n2608.name: File and sarcoma fragments
L24n2608.description: Fires on the word 'file' or 'filename' and on the 'sar' piece of 'sarcoma' split across tokens. Pushes the model toward 'extension' (file extensions).

L22n1856.name: Basic or smallest unit
L22n1856.description: Fires on 'basic' or 'small/smallest' right before a building-block noun such as 'unit' or 'atom' (e.g. 'the basic unit', 'smallest unit'). Pushes the model toward the word 'unit'.

L22n2217.name: SQL SELECT syntax
L22n2217.description: Fires on SQL statement syntax, mostly clause keywords and brackets in SELECT, HAVING, GROUP BY and ORDER BY descriptions (e.g. the '[' before HAVING). Pushes the model toward 'select' and 'SELECT'.

L20n1691.name: Contrast and frequency words
L20n1691.description: Fires on contrast connectives and clause pivots ('but', 'Yet', 'Conversely', 'Indeed') and on the word right after them in expository text. Pushes the model toward frequency and hedge adverbs ('often', 'sometimes', 'usually', 'possibly').

L24n373.name: Pre-verb slot: to, also
L24n373.description: Fires on the word right before an expected main verb: infinitive 'to' after 'trying', 'aimed' or 'been made', and 'should be', 'also', 'fully', 'really', 'not' before a verb. Pushes the model toward the verb 'capture'.

L23n643.name: Adjective before core noun
L23n643.description: Fires on words like 'these', 'essential', 'key', 'important', 'distinctive' and 'structural' that set up a noun phrase naming a core part (e.g. 'these ideas', 'essential element'). Pushes the model toward 'element' or 'elements'.

L23n1384.name: Copula before 'key' predicate
L23n1384.description: Fires on 'is' or sentence-opening 'The' in statements about what matters most ('Knowing is the first step', 'is key to', 'The most important factor'). Pushes the model toward 'key'.

L24n777.name: Punctuation after closing quote
L24n777.description: Fires on a period, comma, question mark or ellipsis placed inside or right after a quotation or bracket (e.g. the '.' in a quoted line ending '.”' or the ',' in a quoted question). Pushes the model toward closing-quote punctuation.

L24n2037.name: Last/next before time unit
L24n2037.description: Fires on 'last', 'next' or 'every' right before a time unit (e.g. 'Last month', 'passed away last year', 'next October'). Pushes the model toward time-unit nouns like 'year', 'month', 'week' and 'night'.

L24n2971.name: Digits in ratios/percents
L24n2971.description: Fires on digits inside percentages, ratios and fractions (the 0 in '70%', the 1 in '1:1', the 3 in '3/4-inch'). Pushes the model toward a colon ':' as in ratio notation.

L23n821.name: Leading digit of numbers
L23n821.description: Fires on the first digit of a multi-digit number, mostly years and large quantities ('2' in '2014', '269 million', '20,000'), plus the comma inside big numbers. Pushes the model toward the HTML entity '&' (e.g. ' ').

L20n1620.name: Question end, blank fill
L20n1620.description: Fires on the '?' that ends a question and on 'is' in 'X is called' definitions, especially in quiz and study prompts. Pushes the model toward blank underscores for fill-in-the-blank.

L23n724.name: Noun before 'method'
L23n724.description: Fires on a noun that usually precedes 'method' in service, form and product text (e.g. 'payment', 'delivery', 'login', 'access', 'funding', 'contraceptive'). Pushes the model toward 'method'.

L24n2059.name: Operation objects in tasks
L24n2059.description: Fires on the object of an operation verb in programming and math task prompts (e.g. 'concatenates them', 'binary addition', 'outputs the array', 'subtract'). Pushes the model toward 'element'.

L21n1480.name: Preposition after failure verbs
L21n1480.description: Fires on the preposition or infinitive right after a word about learning, fearing or overcoming failure (e.g. 'learn from', 'fear of', 'afraid to', 'overcoming'). Pushes the model toward 'error' and 'failure'.

L24n2179.name: Digits inside historical years
L24n2179.description: Fires on the later digits of a year in historical dates (the 0 and 4 in '270 AD', '1150', '336 BCE'). Pushes the model toward era abbreviations such as 'AD' and 'CE'.

L22n1188.name: Genre or style modifier
L22n1188.description: Fires on a genre, format or style word right before its head noun or suffix ('op-ed', 'noir style', 'thriller', 'social media post', 'scientific paper'). Pushes the model toward 'type' and 'kind'.

L24n2749.name: Shape nouns: triangle, trapezoid
L24n2749.description: Fires on 'a' or 'of' right before a geometry shape name (a triangle, a trapezoid, a frustum, a convex polygon) and on pieces of shape words. Pushes the model toward 'triangle'.

L23n221.name: Comma before consequence
L23n221.description: Fires on a comma that closes an if, because or as clause and sets up a consequence ('If exercise is done regularly,'), and on commas inside large numbers. Pushes the model toward 'then', 'thus' and 'therefore'.

L24n1186.name: Word before 'where'
L24n1186.description: Fires on quantifiers and verbs that set up a location or time clause, such as 'every', 'any', 'anywhere', 'going', 'placed', 'found', 'go' and 'no' (e.g. 'found anywhere', 'can go on in'). Pushes the model toward 'where'.

L23n353.name: Clause-end punctuation
L23n353.description: Fires on clause and sentence boundary punctuation (periods, commas, colons, closing quotes, '):') and on 'Find' or 'Create' opening prompts. Pushes closing code delimiters such as '')) and ')))'.

L22n1760.name: 'Relationship' before 'between'
L22n1760.description: Fires on the noun 'relationship' (also correlation, connection, link) right after 'the' in analytical prompts and essays, where 'between' is expected next. Pushes 'between' and its translations.

L24n2667.name: Exact / closed-form solution
L24n2667.description: Fires on words about solving or finding a solution exactly: 'found', 'solved', 'explicit', 'definite', 'exact', 'Find', especially in math text like 'can be found by quadrature'. Pushes 'closed' and 'analytical'.

L21n1335.name: 'by' after passive verbs
L21n1335.description: Fires on 'by' (and 'default') right after a passive or past participle, as in 'not available by default', 'stored by Google', 'swapped by crossing'. Pushes 'by default'.

L23n1463.name: 'True' / truth-value words
L23n1463.description: Fires on 'true' (and the 'be' or 'is' before it) in truth-value and 'is it true' contexts, and on narrative 'telling' and 'return' words. Pushes 'true' and 'false' next.

L22n904.name: Estimates and rough figures
L22n904.description: Fires on words that introduce an approximate or sourced figure: 'rough', 'approximately', 'estimated', 'According to', and the 'to' after 'According'. Pushes 'estimate' and 'calculation'.

L24n2714.name: 'Rec' word-start fragment
L24n2714.description: Fires on the start fragment 'rec' or 're-' of split words (receive, recollection, recycling, recombination) and on 'and' in 'send and receive'. Pushes 'receive' and 'receiving'.

L21n110.name: Digits in years
L21n110.description: Fires on the first digit of years, decades and centuries (the '2' in '2000s' or '20th century', the '1' in '1990s', the '5' in '1950s'). Pushes the next digit tokens such as 0, 4, 9 and 7.

L19n2973.name: Newline after title
L19n2973.description: Fires on the newline that ends a short title, heading or metadata line ('Written by', 'Article number: 645 (2019)', 'Coefficients: fitted coefficients'), often after '?', ')' or ']'. Steering gives only whitespace spam, so the write is unclear.

L22n2178.name: 'Proof' / formal reasoning
L22n2178.description: Fires on words about mathematical proof and formal reasoning ('proof', 'formally', 'logical', 'proven', 'demonstration', 'mathematical') and on 'the' right before 'proof'. Pushes 'proof' and 'prove'.

L22n2106.name: Dictionary and definition wording
L22n2106.description: Fires on 'Dictionary', 'OED', and 'dictionary', and on words that introduce a definition ('define and explain', 'this general definition'). Pushes 'definition' and 'define'.

L22n1834.name: Start-point time phrases
L22n1834.description: Fires on words that mark a start point in time or process: 'From the late 1920s', 'From now on', 'from 1890 onwards', 'Start harvesting', 'from September 2023'. Pushes 'start', 'starting' and 'begin'.

L21n2321.name: 'ur' syllable in names
L21n2321.description: Fires on the 'ur' fragment (also 'Hur', 'Sur', 'Mur', 'Bur') inside split words and proper nouns such as Hurrians, Surinam, murals and Huron. Pushes 'sqrt' and 'square'. The read and write do not clearly match.

L22n1300.name: Copula 'is' before state
L22n1300.description: Fires on 'is' or 'is a' right before a predicate describing a state or validity ('stack is empty', 'is a valid URL', 'is a perfect square'). Pushes 'empty'.

L24n683.name: Frameworks and underscore identifiers
L24n683.description: Fires on framework and product names ('React' in 'React Native', 'Vue', 'Strava') and on the 'FADE IN' screenplay opener, plus some mid-word fragments. Pushes underscore-prefixed code identifiers such as '_js', '_axis' and '_key'.

L23n1622.name: Leading '1' of years
L23n1622.description: Fires on the leading '1' of years in historical dates ('1348', '1580', '1806', '1945', '1.5°C'), and on some capitalized name starts. Pushes 'get' and 'gets'. The read and write do not clearly match.

L24n875.name: Word-start 'ge' / 'le'
L24n875.description: Fires on word-start fragments 'ge', 'le' and 'Le' (lethal, geothermal, Levy, Gary) and on the leading digit of years such as 1947, 1968 and 1754. Pushes 'q' and 'quad'. The read and write do not clearly match.

L23n584.name: Comparison words: like/to/a
L23n584.description: Fires on the word after a comparison marker: 'like' in 'just like', 'to' in 'similar to' or 'compare to', 'a' in 'than a' or 'between a', and 'as'. Pushes 'regular' and 'normal'.

L24n1728.name: Software design pattern terms
L24n1728.description: Fires on terms in software-architecture and design-pattern lists ('Factory', 'Builder', 'Data Mapper', 'Bounded Context', 'Service', 'Consumer', 'MVC') and on commas inside those lists. Pushes 'interface'.

L22n397.name: Word before possessive 's
L22n397.description: Fires on the word right before an apostrophe-s, especially 'today's', 'nation's', 'country's', 'world's', 'Gym's' and 'here's', and on 'today' itself. Pushes "'s".

L22n827.name: Software and programming tools
L22n827.description: Fires negatively on the connector or word just before a named software tool or language in a list, e.g. 'or' in 'R or Python', 'like' in 'apps like Tableau', and on the tool names in data-science and programming text; pushes toward naming software, Python and Java.

L23n1516.name: Determiners after verbs
L23n1516.description: Fires negatively on the determiner right after a verb or preposition in expository prose, e.g. 'your' in 'strengthen your company', 'its' in 'simmer in its liquid', 'the' in 'beyond the previous'; pushes toward 'current', and at higher dose collapses into repeating it.

L24n46.name: Newlines and code openers
L24n46.description: Fires on the line break right after an empty '</think>' tag and on line breaks and openers inside code (MATLAB '%' comment lines, '#include <', backtick fences); pushes toward 'place', 'put' and 'get' verbs and, at +0.5, into garbled 'lost' repetition.

L24n2137.name: Material and metal words
L24n2137.description: Fires on the word or preposition that leads into or sits inside a material list, e.g. 'of' in 'made of cardboard', 'in' in 'encased in precious metals', 'or' in 'zinc-plated steel or stainless steel', and on the material names themselves; pushes toward naming metals, plastics and other materials.

L24n2360.name: 'To' after prompts-the-user
L24n2360.description: Fires negatively on 'to' (and on 'user') in coding-task prompts such as 'prompts the user to', 'allows users to', 'asks the user to', and on 'integer' and 'input' words; pushes toward 'enter', 'entry' and 'input', and at -0.5 it repeats 'entered' and 'entry'.

L1n460.name: Set-phrase second half
L1n460.description: Fires on the second half of a fixed phrase or comparison, e.g. 'not' in 'last but not least', 'than' in 'no less than', 'also' in 'but also', 'one' in 'one by one', 'side' in 'side by side'; pushes toward closing brackets and punctuation, and at +0.5 the output turns into stray symbols.

L21n1228.name: Handle, ignore, remove verbs
L21n1228.description: Fires negatively on the word right after an instruction verb in specs and docs, e.g. 'with' in 'removes instances with unknown', 'has' in 'chars has fewer', 'ignore' and 'handle' after 'should'; pushes toward 'zero', and at -0.5 it spams 'zero'.

L19n1807.name: Since, even, until connectors
L19n1807.description: Fires negatively on time and extent connectors that open a clause, e.g. 'Since' in 'Since then', 'since' in 'ever since 1921', 'even' in 'even then', 'by' in 'out by the 8th week', 'until'; pushes toward 'then', and at -0.5 it repeats 'then'.

L24n1364.name: Method prepositions, name fragments
L24n1364.description: Fires negatively on the preposition ('by', 'to', 'through') linking a method to its goal in technical sentences about attacks, and on the middle of split names ('auc' in Chaucer, 'ern' in Caernarvon, 'Du' in DuPont); pushes toward 'factor' and 'fact'.

L22n899.name: Purpose 'to' clauses
L22n899.description: Fires on 'To' or 'to' opening a purpose clause after prior context, e.g. 'To address this issue', 'designed to evaluate', 'to make sure the reading is accurate', 'double check to make sure'; pushes toward 'check' and 'verify', and at +0.5 it repeats 'Check.'

L24n1130.name: Verbs before 'me'
L24n1130.description: Fires on the verb just before a 'me' or 'let's' object, e.g. 'tell' in 'Can you tell me', 'told' in 'told me', 'given me', 'helped me', 'remember me', 'Let's'; pushes toward the token 'me', and at +0.5 it spams 'me me me'.

L23n710.name: Enumeration and list intros
L23n710.description: Fires on words that introduce an enumeration, e.g. 'just' and 'a few' or 'some' in 'here are just some', 'bullet point' format, 'a list of', and on 'lists' or 'points' in instructions; pushes toward 'list', and at +0.5 it repeats 'list'.

L14n2136.name: Diffuse phrase-completing nouns
L14n2136.description: Fires on the content word that completes a noun or verb phrase across mixed topics, e.g. 'infamous' after 'known for its', 'males' in 'castrated males', 'COVID' before '-19', 'Pages' in 'Number of Pages', 'ticket' in 'buy a ticket'; pushes toward technical-sounding nouns like 'Techniques' and 'Error', and at +0.5 it degenerates into 'For Even For'.

L1n423.name: Mid-word name fragments
L1n423.description: Fires on the second or later piece of a name or word split across tokens, e.g. 'by' in 'Col|by', 'Lib|by', 'yc' in 'Pol|yc|yclic', 'uc' in 'Ha|uc|ourt', 'ly' in 'Regular|ly', and 'Gaul' in 'de Gaulle'; pushes toward closing code such as '})();' and foreign-script fragments.

L22n2444.name: 'In other words' phrases
L22n2444.description: Fires on 'other' in 'In other words' rephrasing and on the digits of word-count targets, e.g. the '0' in 'at least 500 words'; pushes toward 'words' and 'word', and at +0.5 it repeats 'words were words'.

L24n2501.name: Policing and security words
L24n2501.description: Fires on the word just after or inside a police, law or security phrase, e.g. 'police' in 'efficient police force', 'law' and 'enforcement', 'detective', 'crime', and 'air' in 'air rifle' or 'Air Force'; pushes toward 'security' and 'safety'.

L23n1951.name: Modifiers before customer nouns
L23n1951.description: Fires on the adjective or possessive just before a customer, client or audience noun in business and marketing text, e.g. 'its' in 'help its clients', 'their' in 'their target audience', 'prospective' and 'potential' before clients or customers; pushes toward 'client' and 'customers'.

L24n727.name: Split-word first fragment
L24n727.description: Fires on the first fragment of a word broken into pieces, e.g. 'sil' in silhouettes and siliceous, 'sm' in smacking, 'sl' in slotted, 'neuro' in neurotoxic, 'bro' in brochures; pushes toward 'label' and 'labels' with little other meaning.

L24n2796.name: Capital letters opening names
L24n2796.description: Fires on a capital letter or first fragment that opens a proper name mid-sentence, e.g. 'P' in 'Poles', 'Pumsaint' and 'Pteridophyta', 'Rh' in 'Rhododendron', '-P' in 'Boulton-Paul'; pushes toward 'name' and 'names'.

L19n2164.name: Year digits, placeholder braces
L19n2164.description: Fires negatively on heterogeneous mid-token pieces: the digit after '20' in years ('202|0'), the '3' in 'pip3', 'I' in a quoted line, and 'http' after a sentence; pushes toward template placeholders like '{X}', '[args' and 'xxx', and at -0.5 writes '*X*' and '{X} {Y}' filler.

L23n1669.name: Property and attribute nouns
L23n1669.description: Fires negative on words that name a property or attribute in technical specs, e.g. 'height' and 'width' in an attribute list, 'properties' after 'consists of', 'right' in 'left and right'. Pushes toward 'property'.

L22n1352.name: Kind/type phrase words
L22n1352.description: Fires negative on the word inside 'one-of-a-kind', 'of its kind', 'of any type' and 'step-by-step', e.g. '-a' in 'one-of-a-kind' and 'its' before 'kind'. Pushes toward 'type'.

L24n2277.name: Connectives before practice
L24n2277.description: Fires negative on the connective ('into', 'in', 'and', 'with') just before a 'practice' or 'practical' phrase, e.g. 'put into practice', 'in practical terms', 'theory and practice'. Pushes toward 'practice'.

L23n1826.name: Route-travel motion verbs
L23n1826.description: Fires negative on motion verbs that describe a path through a place, e.g. 'ran' for a railway line, 'runs through' for a river, 'flows', 'cuts across', 'passing through'. Pushes toward 'passes', 'passing' and 'through'.

L24n2635.name: Plant, shrub, fruit names
L24n2635.description: Fires positive on botanical words for shrubs, trees, fruits and plant parts, often mid-word in Latin or species names (mangosteen, Cassia, carob, rhizobium, shrub, small tree). Pushes toward 'root'.

L24n2689.name: Form and variant modifiers
L24n2689.description: Fires negative on the modifier that names a version or form of something, e.g. 'Latin-ized' form, 'active' form, 'infinit-ive', 'written' representation, 'archaic' spelling, 'high-risk' variation. Pushes toward 'form'.

L23n2175.name: Product-category nouns in marketing
L23n2175.description: Fires positive on the product or category noun in marketing and product-review prompts (skincare, supplement, diaper, makeup, 'product'), and on the word right before it. Pushes toward 'product'.

L22n230.name: Technical phrase-final tokens
L22n230.description: Diffuse: fires negative on the last word or closing bracket of a technical phrase, e.g. 'View' in 'Datasheet View', '-name' in '<package-name>', the closing parenthesis in '(AWS EC2)', and the token before a closing delimiter in code. Pushes toward closing code punctuation.

L24n494.name: Reply openers, pointer words
L24n494.description: Diffuse: fires positive on the first word of an assistant reply after the empty think block ('Sure'), and on pointer words such as 'below', 'in detail', 'PDF', and 'out' in 'hear me out'. Pushes toward closing code and reply openers.

L24n2276.name: Military service vocabulary
L24n2276.description: Fires positive on military and service words ('Military', 'enlisted', 'served', 'soldiers', 'active service', 'Regiment') and on the relative word after them ('who', 'he', 'can'). Pushes toward 'service'.

L22n1136.name: Qualifier before data type
L22n1136.description: Fires positive on the qualifier or article right before a data-type noun in coding specs: 'positive' before integer, 'list of' before integers or strings, 'an' before integer, 'a' before string. Pushes toward 'integer' and 'string'.

L23n90.name: '(' after a label
L23n90.description: Fires negative on an opening parenthesis or bracket right after a number, label or clause marker, e.g. '(' in '(inches)', '(c)' in copyright lines, '(1)' in statute clauses, 'Eq. ('. At dose -0.5 the output loses its spaces.

L23n2473.name: Comma/dash after aside
L23n2473.description: Fires negative on a comma, dash or parenthesis that closes an introductory phrase or aside, e.g. the comma after 'we are in space' or 'guilty of it', and the em-dash in 'isn't too complex'. Pushes toward 'after'.
L23n2473.name_orig: Comma or dash after an aside

L22n1699.name: 'for'/'over' before timespan
L22n1699.description: Fires positive on 'for', 'over' or 'of' just before a duration, e.g. 'known for centuries', 'over sixty years ago', 'over two decades', 'thousands of years'. Pushes toward 'years', 'decades' and 'centuries'.

L24n948.name: Two-thing comparison contrasts
L24n948.description: Fires negative on 'vastly' in 'vastly different', 'two' in 'two parties' or 'two sets', 'almost' in 'almost exactly the same', and 'at' before 'different heights' or 'rates'. Pushes toward 'opposite', 'opposing' and 'adjacent'.

L23n2757.name: Demonstratives before statistics
L23n2757.description: Fires positive on 'these', 'this', 'those', 'exact' or 'similar' right before a quantity or statistic noun (numbers, facts, deaths, temperatures), e.g. 'these numbers', 'exact number'. Pushes toward 'numbers'.

L22n1313.name: Name fragments, matrix articles
L22n1313.description: Diffuse: fires positive on subword pieces inside names (the 'ur' in Kapurthala, 'our' in Gourdie, 'pp' in Köppen) and on 'a', 'the', 'as' and 'having' in linear-algebra text. Pushes toward 'identity'.

L24n1757.name: HTML element names, determiners
L24n1757.description: Fires positive on HTML and web-UI element names (canvas, input, form, sidebars, elements) and on the article before them, e.g. 'a' in 'a login form' or 'an element'. Pushes toward 'div' and 'element'.

L22n1355.name: Verbs of building into
L22n1355.description: Fires negative on the verb of incorporating one thing into another: 'built' in 'built into the barrel', 'woven' into, 'integrated' into, 'incorporated', and 'be' in 'can be integrated' or 'should be used'. Pushes toward 'integrate'.

L24n1452.name: Database connection request
L24n1452.description: Fires on database-product names (MySQL, MongoDB, SQLite, 'database', 'DB') in coding prompts, peaking on the product name before the word 'database'. Pushes the model toward 'connect' and 'connection'.

L20n1453.name: Exclamation after headline words
L20n1453.description: Fires on the emphatic word that ends a headline or call-to-action ('Now', 'Wow', 'Coming', 'Read More', 'Vote') in promotional text. Pushes the model toward '!' and markdown image starts.

L22n2143.name: Variation and difference modifiers
L22n2143.description: Fires on the modal or adjective just before a variation word, such as 'may' in 'may vary', or 'pronounced', 'substantial', 'ethnic' before 'differences'. Pushes the model toward 'variation' or 'differences'.

L20n2391.name: Closing parens and digits
L20n2391.description: Fires on a single digit inside a multi-digit number, and on a closing parenthesis after an item or number, in tables, citations and stats. Pushes the model toward '))' closers, with no clear effect in prose.

L23n785.name: 'the' before anatomy nouns
L23n785.description: Fires on 'the' (or 'of the', 'over the') right before a body part or physical object in medical and technical prose, e.g. 'damages the small intestine'. Pushes the model toward 'value' tokens.

L23n571.name: Short and number-unit prompts
L23n571.description: Fires on 'short' before story, bio or essay in writing prompts, and on a number or '.js' right before a unit or word ('500-word', '5-year', 'Node.js'). Pushes the model toward '+N'-style tokens, with no clear effect.

L24n706.name: Word-start fragments, max/min
L24n706.description: Fires on the first fragment of a longer word split into pieces, e.g. 'Ed' in 'Edexcel' or 'Sim' in 'Simulating'. Pushes the model toward 'max' and 'min' tokens.

L23n1621.name: Divide and fold grouping
L23n1621.description: Fires on 'to' before 'divide', 'fold' in 'threefold', and 'equal' in 'equal groups', i.e. words about splitting or grouping. Pushes the model toward 'divide' and 'division'.

L23n2905.name: Center and middle locations
L23n2905.description: Fires on 'the' or 'their' right before a center or middle location noun ('the center of', 'at their centres', 'through the middle'). Pushes the model toward 'center' and 'centre'.

L1n1919.name: Prepositions after nouns
L1n1919.description: Fires on a preposition, 'that' or 'and' right after a noun phrase head, e.g. 'change in', 'end of', 'assembled by'. Pushes the model toward meaningless code-like tokens with no clear effect.

L24n2104.name: Proper-noun start fragments
L24n2104.description: Fires on the first sub-token of a capitalized proper noun split into pieces, e.g. 'Har' in Harpenden or Harriet, 'Bag' in Shalimar Bagh. Pushes the model toward '%' format tokens, with no clear effect.

L23n2798.name: Automation and autonomy words
L23n2798.description: Fires on 'auto' word-starts and the word just before them ('to' in 'manual to automatic', 'semi-aut' in 'semi-autonomous', 'auto' in 'auto responders'). Pushes the model toward 'automatic' and 'automated'.

L23n2933.name: Machine and body parts
L23n2933.description: Fires on a noun naming a machine or body part (automotive, motor, body, moving, machinery), often right after 'on the' or 'of'. Pushes the model toward 'parts' next.

L16n899.name: CJK characters
L16n899.description: Fires on a CJK character (Chinese hanzi, Japanese kanji or kana, Korean hangul) inside a non-English sentence or heading, e.g. 勇 or 健康. Pushes the model toward CJK punctuation such as 、 。 （.

L21n1360.name: Slot before 'usually/often'
L21n1360.description: Fires on the token just before a generic statement's frequency slot, e.g. 'are' in 'tinnitus are caused' or 'plans' in 'These plans are typically'. Pushes the model toward 'usually', 'often' and 'typically'.

L23n2144.name: Data-structure nouns, pointers
L23n2144.description: Fires on data-structure nouns in coding prompts ('array', 'node', 'string', 'matrix', 'list'). Pushes the model toward 'pointer' and 'ptr' tokens.

L23n982.name: first/last ordinal words
L23n982.description: Fires on 'first', 'final' and 'last' and the 'and' or 'at' that sets them up ('first and second', 'as a last resort', 'at last'). Pushes the model toward 'last'.

L23n1572.name: Clause-start fragments, there/exist
L23n1572.description: Fires on the token just before a clause-level slot ('∂' before 'the covariant', 'which' in 'for which', 'that' in 'prove that') and on name fragments such as 'Dor' or 'Emb'. Pushes the model toward 'there' and 'exist'.

L24n8.name: 'sal'/'hal' word fragments
L24n8.description: Fires on the 'sal' or 'hal' opening fragment of a word split into pieces ('sal|ivary', 'Sal|azar', 'hal|ting'). Pushes the model toward rare, noisy tokens with no clear effect.

L23n1259.name: Input/output prepositions
L23n1259.description: Fires on the preposition or article right after an input or output verb in coding prompts ('from the user', 'as input', 'on' in 'display on'). Pushes the model toward 'print' and 'console'.

L14n178.name: Non-Latin script tokens
L14n178.description: Goes strongly negative on the first token of a CJK, Thai, Arabic, Cyrillic or Korean word embedded in English text (e.g. 勇, 健康, พระ, ابن), and weakly on full-width punctuation. Pushes the model to write CJK and full-width punctuation (，。；：).

L22n966.name: Deletion and list commas
L22n966.description: Fires on commas and 'and/or' inside lists of software operations (e.g. 'create, read, update,' or 'insertion, deletion'), and on delete/remove words such as 'deletion', 'delete' and 'Click'. Pushes the model to write 'del' tokens (del, Del, _del).

L20n1480.name: Enthusiastic reply openers
L20n1480.description: Goes strongly negative on the first word of an assistant reply after the empty think block, such as 'Certainly', 'Sure', 'Thanks', 'Yes' or 'Enjoy', peaking on 'Certainly' or 'Sure' before a comma. Pushes the model toward exclamation marks '!'.

L24n1444.name: Reflect and think words
L24n1444.description: Fires on 'think', 'thought', 'reflect' and nearby reflective words like 'quiet' and 'philosophical' (e.g. 'Have you ever thought', 'pause to reflect'), peaking on the verb itself. Pushes the model to write 'reflection' and 'reflect' forms.

L24n1857.name: Word before 'state'
L24n1857.description: Fires on the modifier right before 'state' or 'health' in phrases like 'current state', 'mental health', 'emotional state' or 'psychological wellness', peaking on 'mental', 'current' or 'psychological'. Pushes the model to write 'state' tokens.

L22n1720.name: Research lead-in commas
L22n1720.description: Fires on the comma that closes a news lead-in ('In a new study,', 'In the 1970s,', 'following a stroke,') and on 'by' or 'led by' before a research team, peaking there. Pushes the model to write 'scientists' and 'researchers'.

L23n1307.name: Writing-task document terms
L23n1307.description: Goes strongly negative on tokens in writing-assignment prompts (email, letter, essay, blog, 'your' in 'In your letter'), usually the word just before the requested content. Pushes the model toward 'body' (email body, body of a letter).

L23n2106.name: Split-word first fragments
L23n2106.description: Fires on the first subword piece of a longer word or name that is split into tokens (e.g. 'wil' in wildebeest, 'Hos' in Hosack, 'Lib' in Libertarian, 'ob' in Gobitis), peaking on that opening fragment. Pushes the model toward 'other' and 'others'.

L23n981.name: On/top placement prepositions
L23n981.description: Goes strongly negative on 'on', 'onto' and 'over' after placement verbs ('placed on', 'put on', 'applied on', 'drip stuff on top'), peaking on the preposition just before a surface or 'top' location. Pushes the model to write 'top' (on top, top of).

L23n1923.name: Token before 'space(s)'
L23n1923.description: Goes strongly negative on connector words in task or spec sentences ('by' in 'separated by spaces', 'have' in 'can have spaces', 'double' in 'double-spaced'), peaking on the word just before a 'space' idea. Pushes the model to write 'space' and 'spaces'.

L22n1230.name: Determiner before sum/calc
L22n1230.description: Goes strongly negative on determiners and adjectives ('the', 'a', 'their', 'weighted') that open a noun phrase about a computed quantity (greatest common divisor, the sum of, a weighted appraisal), and on 'calculate' words. Pushes the model to write 'sum'.

L24n2630.name: Capital L name starts
L24n2630.description: Goes strongly negative on a capital 'L' that starts a proper name or title (László, Lihle, Lori, Linda, Lotto), peaking on the lone 'L' token. Pushes the model to write 'get' tokens.

L21n1442.name: Your/favourite before choice
L21n1442.description: Fires on 'your', 'their', 'top', 'favourite' and superlatives like 'popular', 'best' right before a selection noun ('of your choice', 'top candidate', 'favorite of'). Pushes the model to write 'choice' tokens.

L19n834.name: Marine and sea words
L19n834.description: Goes strongly negative on 'marine', 'sea', 'ocean', 'coastal', 'waters' and 'ships', peaking on 'marine' or 'sea' in any context (marine life, sea turtles, sea floor). Pushes the model to write 'marine', 'fish', 'sailor' and 'maritime'.

L8n908.name: Sea and ship words
L8n908.description: Fires on sea, ocean, ship and harbour words, and on the location word right after them ('off' in 'waters off Christmas Island', 'coast' after 'the'), peaking on 'off' or 'sea'. Pushes the model to write 'shore', 'reef', 'ocean' and 'coastal'.

L22n842.name: Multiply and arithmetic operations
L22n842.description: Operation names in math text, peaking on the comma in an 'add, subtract, divide, multiply' list and on 'multip' in 'multiplication'. Pushes the model to write 'multiply' and 'product'.

L23n855.name: Colon before a figure
L23n855.description: The colon or newline right after 'below' or 'shown below' that introduces a picture, infographic or meme, and the blank line after a closing think tag. Pushes the model to write '!' and markdown image syntax '![]'.

L24n811.name: Place-name first subword
L24n811.description: The first sub-word piece of a capitalised place name split into tokens, e.g. 'Bl' in Pine Bluff, 'Mack' in Mackinac, 'Moz' in Mozambique, 'Ph' in Phatthalung, mostly after 'of', 'in' or a comma. Pushes the model toward code type names like Number, Buffer and String, with little visible effect on prose.

L23n1349.name: Never and give up
L23n1349.description: 'never' (peak) and 'give' before 'up', plus 'from' in 'keep from' and 'to' in 'refused to'; fires where text is about quitting or ceasing. Pushes the model to write 'stop' and 'stopping'.

L21n1412.name: Numbering and rank words
L21n1412.description: 'number' in rank phrases ('number one', 'number-one killer') and the label word after a list marker ('Phase One', 'Fact', 'Article', 'Bill', 'Figure', 'Pit #24'). Pushes the model to write 'number' or '#'.

L24n2291.name: Split name's later piece
L24n2291.description: A later sub-word piece of a name split into tokens: the 'y' in Che|y|enne, 'ikh' in Tikhonov, 'ray' in Phraya, 'Koh' in Kohli, 'Kos' in Kosrae. Pushes the model toward the letter 'X' or 'Y' and invented names like 'Xyser'.

L22n2757.name: 'Into' before implementation
L22n2757.description: The word just before an act-it-out verb or noun: 'into' in 'into practice', 'to' in 'to implement', 'and' in 'plan, design and execute', 'for' in 'timeline for implementation'. Pushes the model toward 'implementation', 'implement' and 'execution'.

L21n2467.name: Temporary and quick fixes
L21n2467.description: Words for a short-term or quick fix: 'term' in 'short-term' and 'long-term', 'temporary', 'quick', 'easiest', 'simpler', 'convenient', 'homemade', and 'One' opening a list of risks or methods. Pushes the model toward 'solution'.

L24n1201.name: Measurement numbers and units
L24n1201.description: Numbers and unit words inside a length, area or size spec: the last digit of a range or dimension ('3' in 0.2-0.3 in., '10' in 10 feet) and 'square' in '100 square feet'. Pushes the model toward metric length units like meters, cm and mm.

L24n2866.name: Value, money, and assets
L24n2866.description: Money and asset words, peaking on 'present' in 'present value' and 'value' in 'intrinsic value', plus asset nouns like assets, collateral, currency, commodity, credits, treasure and jewelry. Pushes the model toward 'value' and 'worth'.

L23n2114.name: American and European pieces
L23n2114.description: The 'amer' piece of Meso|amer|ica and 'American' in organisation names (American Heart Association), plus 'European', 'Euras' and 'Eu' in Euromonitor. Pushes the model toward 'delete'; its effect on normal text is weak.

L23n631.name: Sequence length in code
L23n631.description: In code-writing requests and docs, the word for the data being processed or returned: 'equal' before 'length', 'the' before 'longest one', 'array' in 'outputs the array', 'chars' and 'has' in 'chars has fewer than n characters'. Pushes the model toward 'length'.

L24n2994.name: Watching and listening media
L24n2994.description: Words about watching or listening to media: 'watched', 'watch', the 've' in 'you've watched', 'TV', 'YouTube', 'videos', 'podcasts', 'listeners' and 'fans'. Pushes the model toward 'watch' and 'view'.

L22n1293.name: Data type in specs
L22n1293.description: The noun naming the data in a code spec or function doc: 'a' in 'Returns a string', the quoted parameter 'email', 'XML' data, 'number' in 'binary number', 'as' in 'input from the user'. Pushes the model toward 'string' and 'str'.

L24n2961.name: Work and trade nouns
L24n2961.description: Job and trade words: 'of' after 'scope' in 'scope of work', 'work' in 'work required' or 'work must be inspected', 'construction', 'maintenance', 'wiring', 'welding', 'electrical' and 'cleanup'. Pushes the model toward 'work'.

L22n1946.name: 'Defines' and 'definition' words
L22n1946.description: Words that introduce a definition or spec: 'defines' and 'define' ('M-file that defines'), 'terminology', 'formally', 'Definitions:', 'Parameters', and the '%' comment marker in MATLAB code. Pushes the model toward 'definition' and 'define'.

L19n3020.name: Clause-linking 'as' and 'and'
L19n3020.description: The conjunction 'as' or 'and' that opens or joins a clause giving a result or reason ('as a result', 'as soon as', 'and we can't fully process', 'and not an every day occurrence'), plus 'That is to say'. Pushes the model toward 'therefore', 'thus' and 'hence'.

L24n2417.name: Leftover and remaining words
L24n2417.description: Words for what is left over: the 'the' in 'fill the remaining part', 'days' and 'hours' in 'a few days left', 'the extra', 'the rest', plus 'fill', 'bury' and 'compost'. Pushes the model toward 'remain', 'remaining' and 'remained'.

L21n1463.name: Name and label words
L21n1463.description: Words that name or label something: 'names' and 'name', 'by' in 'call it by some other name', 'with' in 'replace __ with', 'spelling', 'Type', 'numeral', 'Color' and 'currency'. Pushes the model toward 'name'.

L24n954.name: 'Genetically' and lasting change
L24n954.description: 'genetically' and 'etic' pieces of genetic and genetics, plus 'forever' in 'changed forever' and 'altered forever', and the 't' of 'don't result in'. Pushes the model toward 'modification', 'mod' and 'modify'.

L24n1824.name: C language name, brackets
L24n1824.description: Goes strongly negative on the letter 'C' naming the C language in coding prompts ("C++", "C#", "in C"), peaking on the 'C' just before '++' or '#'; weaker on array-like tokens such as 'chars' and '[ch'. Pushes the model toward writing empty '[]' and array-bracket tokens, and its steered output adds '[1]'-style markers to plain prose.

L23n2904.name: Anticipates solving/solution
L23n2904.description: Fires (goes negative) on the word just before an expected solve/solution word: 'a' in 'found a way to', 'to' in 'impossible to answer', 'be' in 'can be solved', 'problem' in 'problem-solving'. Pushes the model to write 'solution'/'solve' next.
